Amazon MGM Studios is the home for talent, creating and producing Original films and series for a global audience. Original series premiere exclusively on Prime Video, which is available in more than 240 countries and territories worldwide. Amazon MGM Studios also produces and acquires Original movies for theatrical release and exclusively for Prime Video.

The Head of Series Photo Production leads and manages a high-performing team of photo producers responsible for the vision, strategy, and execution of all photography production across Amazon MGM Studios' original series content slate. This role oversees the full lifecycle of photo production and post-production, from concept through final delivery, across a large and diverse portfolio of series campaigns.

The Head of Series Photo Production is responsible for driving team-wide production excellence, establishing and refining operational processes, managing vendor relationships and contracts, and ensuring every campaign meets Amazon's bar for creative quality.
This team functions as a centralized photo production group serving multiple internal partners—including Publicity, Marketing, Social/Digital, Product, and Key Art—rather than any single function. The Head of Series Photo Production partners across all of these groups to ensure photography strategy, creative, and delivery align with each team’s needs.

The ideal candidate is a seasoned creative production leader who is passionate about visual storytelling and deeply experienced in both photography production and post-production workflows. They understand how photo assets function within a global marketing campaign and bring a strong operational mindset to building scalable, efficient team processes. They are well-versed in SAG-AFTRA, DGA rules and regulations and have extensive experience communicating with talent representatives, showrunners, and senior stakeholders across the entertainment industry.

This role is based in Culver City, CA. Travel will be required.

This is a greenfield role. You'll build a product management practice, shape an entirely new category at AWS, and establish the engagement model that delivers delightful outcomes enabling customers to transform themselves.

**The Role**

As the Director of Product Management — Forward Deployed Engineering will lead product management for FDE, building and leading the PM team that owns the end-to-end product lifecycle from customer engagement through production delivery through optimization and self-sufficiency. Your product managers embed directly inside enterprise customers — defining outcomes, writing specs, working hand-in-hand with engineering to ship production systems — and every engagement feeds back into AWS services and an underlying platform that makes the next one faster.

This is not a traditional AWS Product Management role. You are the "CEO of the customer problem" — responsible for the *why* and *what*, while engineering owns the *how*.

You see what breaks  across deployments and turn that into product direction. You influence AWS service roadmap from a position of earned authority because you've lived the deployment pain firsthand, and identify when custom pod work should graduate into platform primitives or native service capabilities.

You shape the FDE engagement model: how we scope, what we deliver, what we price, what we leave behind.

You build the domain expertise that compounds. Your teams develop industry-specific accelerators, reference architectures, and blueprints that generate pipeline for the next customer in your vertical. You define the use cases that feed qualification, pricing, and pod composition. You measure what matters: asset reuse rate, time-to-value, engagement velocity

You partner with sales, specialists, and marketing to define pricing, packaging, and positioning. You own the commercial model for FDE engagements — how we price outcomes, what the customer buys, and how we demonstrate ROI. You build pipeline through customer stories, reference architectures

Prime Video is building one of the world's most ambitious entertainment services: originals, live sports, licensed content, and new formats for customers in 240+ countries, across subscriptions, channels, rentals and purchases, and ad-supported streaming.

This role owns the technology for how Prime Video acquires, engages, and retains those customers. ashby:adaptyv:77084f0d-2ac2-46da-bc3a-8c.description:
Adaptyv is building an automated lab that lets AI agents run biology experiments. 

We're entering the era of agentic science where AI models can now design novel proteins, propose hypotheses, and iterate on experimental results. But they can't run the experiments themselves - that's still a manual, months-long process. We're building the infrastructure that gives AI agents access to the physical world.

We are one of the fastest growing biotech companies, trusted by leading biopharmas, frontier AI labs, and the techbio companies pushing the field forward. This is a rare chance to help advance some of the most important work happening in biotech today.

Our automated lab is powered by a deep software + hardware stack: lab instruments worth millions of USD reverse-engineered into API-controllable hardware, dozens of devices orchestrated through complex workflows, full observability on everything that happens in the lab, processing pipelines for messy physical-world data, and AI systems that troubleshoot production results and accelerate assay development.

We’re growing rapidly and are hiring for talented people to scale and support the massive demand for AI-driven wet lab experimentation.


ABOUT THE ROLE

As AI designs more of biology, the bottleneck moves to experiments: running them fast, at scale and with data people can trust. Adaptyv is the company best positioned to become the verification layer for biology, and long-term partnerships with pharma, biotech and frontier AI labs are how we get there.

You find the partners where Adaptyv can become core infrastructure. You shape the terms, and you run the deal: scientific scope, pricing, legal, and the internal plan to deliver it. You also design new partnership models and the deals that do not fit a standard quote.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Lead the largest deals. Source, structure and close strategic partnerships with pharma, biotech and frontier AI labs.

 - Set the terms. Pricing, data rights, exclusivity, milestones. You find structures where both sides win.

 - Align the company behind each deal. The lab, the scientists and engineering deliver what you sign, so you bring them in early.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Deal-maker with a track record. You have closed complex, high-value deals in life sciences, AI or deep tech. Biopharma BD, corporate development or partnerships experience is ideal. We will also bet on rising talent.

 - Credible with scientists. You can follow a discussion about binding data and assay design, and you know when to bring in the expert.

 - High agency. Nobody hands you a pipeline. You build it, and you own the outcome.

 - AI-native. It's 2026: you use Claude and similar tools every day for research, modeling and drafting, and you check what they produce.

 - Low ego, high EQ. Partners trust you, and so does the team.



Application deadline

We are reviewing applicants on a rolling basis.

As these dollars move, they need performance-grade pipes; Agentio is how those dollars flow to creators with the speed, control, and measurement marketers expect. We enable brands like Uber, DoorDash, and Bombas to run creator campaigns with the same rigor, control, and accountability as their core performance channels.

An $800B market. A once-in-a-generation technology shift. This is the moment. This is the team. Come build something generational with us.

That covers platform partnerships, channel sales partnerships, measurement partnerships, and product partnership opportunities. Blackpoint Cyber is the leading provider of world-class cybersecurity threat hunting, detection and remediation technology. Founded by former National Security Agency (NSA) cyber operations experts who applied their learnings to bring national security-grade technology solutions to commercial customers around the world, Blackpoint Cyber is in hyper-growth mode,  fueled by a recent $190m series C round. 


Company Culture

At Blackpoint Cyber, we value high-quality execution, ownership, and strong morals. Our principles are never tested, and we are proud to always do right by our customers. We are an energetic and collaborative team that maintains a high-performance culture and enables growth by overcoming challenges in the modern cyber threat landscape. If you are a driven professional with a passion for learning and contributing at a high level, Blackpoint Cyber welcomes you.

Position Overview
You will lead the engineering organization that builds our core product: finding threats across customer environments and getting them to the SOC fast. Reports to the Head of Engineering.

Scope

 - SIEM and log analytics

 - Endpoint detection and response

 - Identity threat detection

 - A rapid-response team focused on emerging threats

 - Quality engineering and architecture for detection systems

Responsibilities

 - Own detection coverage and quality: fewer missed threats, fewer false positives, faster time to detect.

 - Build detection-as-code practices: versioned rules, test data, regression suites and safe rollout.

 - Treat the SOC as your primary customer, and turn their escalations into fixes and coverage improvements.

 - Partner with ML engineering to bring AI-assisted detection and triage into production safely.

 - Improve the quality and consistency of the data detections depend on, with platform partners.

 - Respond quickly to new attack techniques, with a clear process from threat research to shipped detection.

 - Lead distributed teams, including contractors, with clear ownership and quality standards.

 - Hire and develop engineers and leaders; grow team leads into managers.

Required

 - 10+ years in software engineering, 3+ leading multiple teams or managers.

 - Hands-on background in security engineering: SIEM, EDR/MDR, identity or cloud detection.

 - Experience running high-volume event pipelines where data loss is not acceptable.

 - Ability to work closely with SOC analysts and turn their needs into engineering priorities.

Preferred

 - Detection engineering experience: MITRE ATT&CK mapping, rule authoring, threat hunting.

 - Experience managing offshore or contractor teams.

 - MSP or MDR provider background.

Blackpoint Cyber welcomes and encourages applications from qualified individuals of all races, colors, religions, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, marital status, or any other legally protected status. ashby:conveo.ai:a23ca8f7-ec94-43ce-8be8-.description:
Own Conveo's data, from the warehouse to the dashboard, and build the team every part of the business relies on.

This role can be based from either our London or Antwerp location.

Conveo is building the AI-powered infrastructure for consumer understanding, making consumer and B2B research fast, affordable and high quality. Global brands such as Unilever, Google and Orange use our AI video interviewer to generate insights across their marketing, product and research teams.

Backed by Y Combinator, we're in a period of rapid growth. We started this year with around 20 people and are on track to reach around 120 by year end, so the people who join now have an outsized chance to shape how the company is built.

We raised a $50M Series A led by DST Global, giving us the fuel to move even faster. We’re investing in our product, growing an exceptional team, and taking on bigger challenges as we enter our next stage of growth.




THE ROLE

You'll be our first Head of Data. You'll own internal data at Conveo and build the team that serves the whole company with it.

You won't be starting from a blank page. Our GTM engineering team has built a data warehouse and semantic layer and has made a start on BI, and colleagues in operations have helped shape our metric definitions. What we don't have is one person who owns all of it, knows what good looks like, and turns it into something every team trusts and uses.

You'll report to our CFO and work very closely with our CTO, as well as with the engineering team, operations and go-to-market. This is a hands-on role. You'll be in the data yourself, not writing a strategy and handing it over. You'll start as the first member of the data team, with a remit to hire as we grow.

This is a role for the long term, not an audit-and-leave project. It starts with the foundations and grows into a bigger team, with room for machine learning and data science to help us predict more across the business.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

Own the data stack end to end

 - Take ownership of our warehouse (Google BigQuery), our transformation and semantic layers (dbt and Cube today) and our BI tooling (Metabase today)

 - Review what's been built with a critical eye, and get it ready to scale as new tools and data sources come in

 - Think through access rights, so it's clear who can see customer, HR and financial data once it all lives in one place

Build one source of truth the business trusts

 - Own metric definitions, so every team works from the same numbers

 - Close the gaps that matter most, starting with areas like marketing attribution and the data our finance team needs for its analysis

 - Make our data reliable enough that people trust it and act on it

Turn data into insight for every team

 - Sit down with department leads, get to the real question behind a request, and build the analysis that answers it

 - Act as the translator between engineering and the business: ask engineers the hard questions about what to build, and e

Crux is being capitalized to plan every layer together, develop each one to demanding standards, and operate the whole system with efficiency and reliability. That gives hyperscalers, frontier AI labs, sovereign customers, enterprises, and AI-native companies greater freedom to pursue the AI they are here to create.

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO

You will build the team from near zero while delivering our first production TPU clusters, and you will run it as an engineered system, with automation and AI agents doing the work that other operators staff with people.



In this role, you will:

 - Run the operating relationship with Google and our rack integration and manufacturing partners on build quality, delivery schedules, failure analysis, RMA, and corrective action.

 - Partner with Capacity Delivery and Facility Operations so that every site moves from rack arrival to customer-ready capacity on the committed date, and own the readiness gates at that handoff.

 - Build and lead the site ServerOps teams and the technicians, engineers, and managers who keep the fleet healthy, with safety and quality standards that hold at every site.

 - Own the fleet metrics that matter to customers: share of capacity in service, time to repair, failure rates by component, and time from rack arrival to customer-ready, and review them every week.

 - Lead new hardware introductions with Compute, Network Engineering, and Google, so that each new TPU generation and rack design is deployable, serviceable, and operable at scale before it reaches the floor.

 - Work with AI Ops to automate diagnosis, repair dispatch, and RMA workflows, so the fleet grows faster than the team that runs it.

Join d-Matrix and help build the future of AI inference. We’ve pioneered a memory-centric architecture that brings compute directly into memory, making AI faster, more energy efficient, and accessible on a global scale. From chips and software to rack-scale systems, our team is tackling some of AI infrastructure’s hardest challenges — and shipping breakthrough technology today. If you want to create what comes next and help make infinite inference possible, we’d love to hear from you.

Our culture is built on respect, collaboration, and direct communication. We value humility, we believe our different perspectives lead to better solutions, and we’re looking for people who are driven by execution and energized by hard problems.



Role Overview

The platform software layer sits between hardware bring-up and the workload stack. It determines whether a rack-scale AI accelerator system powers on, joins its fabric, passes validation, and stays healthy in the field. As the senior leader of platform software, you will own the physical platform layer: device and link discovery, health, fault detection, readiness gating, firmware and BMC integration, and bring-up and fleet tooling. You will build the team that delivers it and publish a clean, versioned interface to the fabric manager, runtime, and schedulers above it. You will partner closely with hardware, runtime, diagnostics, validation, deployment, operations, and product teams.

What you will do

 - Own node, rack, and cluster bring-up software, including discovery, provisioning, configuration, and readiness gating before any workload traffic, in partnership with the fabric software team.

 - Define and maintain a versioned interface between the platform layer and the workload stack (fabric manager, runtime, and schedulers), with explicit state transitions and events pushed to consumers rather than inferred.

 - Own device and link discovery and health, and publish normalized state and events for devices and links across their lifecycle.

 - Drive fault detection and classification, including severity-based handling, escalation paths, and hand-offs to recovery owners and data center operations.

 - Own firmware, BMC, and low-level platform software integration, packaging, and update flows.

 - Deliver health telemetry, diagnostics integration, and fleet monitoring for deployed clusters, and integrate with orchestration so the platform layer owns device and fabric readiness.

 - Build tooling and recipes to turn up, stabilize, and hand off initial clusters to production operations at a defined readiness threshold, with feedback loops to hardware, diagnostics, manufacturing, and field teams.

 - Hire and lead the platform software team, owning technical direction, milestones, quality, and on-call, and convert open architecture documents into owned, dated deliverables.

What you will bring

 - Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical or Computer Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent pr

Founded on the principles of innovation, integrity, and customer-centricity, DC BLOX provides cutting-edge colocation, cloud services, and network solutions tailored to our clients' unique needs.



Our team is made up of passionate professionals dedicated to excellence. We foster a collaborative and inclusive workplace culture where every voice is valued and innovation is encouraged. Whether you’re an experienced industry veteran or just starting your career, DC BLOX offers a range of opportunities for growth and development.

Description Summary:

The Vice President, Design & Engineering is accountable for converting approved product strategy, customer requirements, and development priorities into safe, reliable, scalable, cost-effective, and constructible data center designs. This leader owns the design portfolio from early technical due diligence and Basis of Design through permitting, issued-for-construction documentation, construction administration, commissioning support, and turnover to Operations.



The VP leads DC BLOX’s design management function and core mechanical, electrical, and controls engineering leaders, while directing external architects, engineers, consultants, and design-build partners. The role works in close partnership with Product & Innovation to deploy and improve standard products; with Operations Engineering to incorporate reliability and commissioning lessons; and with Development, Construction, Procurement, Sales, Finance, and Operations to deliver capacity on schedule, within approved cost, and at the quality expected by DC BLOX customers.



Essential Duties:

Design Portfolio Leadership and Delivery

 - Lead the design portfolio for hyperscale, government, edge, colocation, expansion, retrofit, and infrastructure upgrade programs.

 - Establish portfolio priorities, resource plans, stage gates, decision calendars, and escalation paths aligned with development and delivery schedules.

About Delinea:
Delinea is the identity security platform that continuously controls what AI agents, humans and machines can do and for how long. It extends privileged access management from the point of access to the moment of action, using just-in-time authorization to reduce standing privilege across on-premises, multi-cloud and short-lived infrastructure, without adding friction for legitimate users. Delinea provides visibility across every identity type, scores the risk each one carries, and preserves the context behind access decisions, making them auditable and defensible. It supports both static and ephemeral access, letting teams apply Zero Standing Privilege where risk demands it without replacing existing infrastructure.

ABOUT MATTER HEALTH

Matter Health delivers primary and preventive healthcare directly to older adults living in affordable housing communities. Our mission is simple: to improve healthcare access by meeting patients where they are and building trusted relationships within the communities we serve.

As we rapidly expand, we are seeking mission-driven professionals who thrive in fast-paced, people-centered environments.

We Lead with Love in Everything We Do.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Matter Health is seeking an experienced Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) to lead and continuously strengthen our enterprise information security program.

Our value-based care model depends on the trust of our patients, providers, and payer partners. Protecting sensitive health information across our distributed, field-based care delivery model is essential to maintaining that trust.

Reporting to the Chief Technology Officer, the CISO will be responsible for developing and executing Matter Health's information security strategy, establishing security policies and governance frameworks, overseeing cybersecurity operations, and ensuring compliance with applicable healthcare security regulations.

This is a high-visibility, hands-on executive leadership opportunity for someone who enjoys building and scaling security programs within a growing healthcare organization. The CISO will work closely with Technology, Clinical Operations, Compliance, and executive leadership to strengthen organizational security while supporting continued growth.

The position will initially oversee a cybersecurity analyst and work alongside an external contractor supporting Matter Health's HITRUST certification efforts.

The ideal candidate brings deep healthcare cybersecurity expertise, strong executive leadership capabilities, and the ability to balance enterprise-level security standards with the flexibility and adaptability required in a growth-stage environment.




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Information Security Strategy & Leadership

 - Develop, implement, and continuously evolve Matter Health's enterprise information security strategy, ensuring alignment with organizational goals, clinical operations, and regulatory requirements.

 - Establish and maintain security policies, standards, and procedures covering data protection, access controls, acceptable use, and third-party risk management.

 - Build and mature security governance frameworks, including NIST CSF and HITRUST CSF, appropriate for an organization handling protected health information (PHI).

 - Lead security budget planning, vendor selection, and technology investments while balancing security needs with organizational priorities.

 - Manage and develop internal cybersecurity resources while collaborating with external security partners and consultants.

 - Provide regular security updates, risk assessments, and strategic recommendations to executive leadership, including occasional presentations to the Board of Directors.

OpenLoop was co-founded by CEO, Dr. Jon Lensing, and COO, Christian Williams, with the vision to bring care anywhere. Our telehealth support solutions are thoughtfully designed to streamline and simplify go-to-market care delivery for companies offering meaningful virtual support to patients across an expansive array of specialties, in all 50 states.



We are the digital health infrastructure powering modern medicine. Healthcare and non-healthcare brands use our white-label platform to launch, scale and run virtual and hybrid care without the operational complexity. We bring together one of the largest telehealth clinician networks in the country, nationwide payer coverage, integrated pharmacy and lab partners, EHR connectivity, 24/7 patient support and full revenue cycle management. ashby:quo:c6343e67-f8fa-4cbc-bdb6-9299e2.description:
Small businesses represent 99.9% of all companies, yet they're still forced to choose between clunky, outdated enterprise phone systems or their personal phones. This multi-billion dollar market has been overlooked for decades, left to cobble together solutions that slow them down instead of helping them grow.

 

Quo is changing that. We bring calls, texts, and customer information together into one easy-to-use, AI-powered platform. We're not just building a phone system. We're setting a new standard for how businesses connect with their customers.

 

Driven by our values, we move fast, build with determination, and obsess over delivering value to the businesses that have been underserved for far too long.

 

Today, Quo is trusted by more than 120,000 companies and rated #1 in customer satisfaction on G2. We're backed by Y Combinator, Tiger Global, Craft Ventures, Slow Ventures, and other top-tier investors. It's safe to say we're onto something big.


ABOUT THE ROLE



We're looking for a Director of Technical Support to build Tier 3 Technical Support from the ground up. Tier 3 will be our specialist support engineering function for the most complex customer issues across our AI products, Model Context Protocol (MCP) capabilities, APIs, integrations, and telecom infrastructure.



Tier 2 has built a strong foundation, and Tier 3 will build on it. You'll define the mandate, hire and grow the team, and establish clear ownership and handoffs across Support, Product, Engineering, and Engineering QA. You'll partner closely with Support leadership, who will continue to own Tier 1 and Tier 2 performance.



You'll build the team's ability to investigate complex issues, reproduce defects, deliver actionable technical escalations, and validate fixes with Engineering and QA. You'll set standards for technical judgment and customer ownership, with accountability for faster diagnosis, reliable resolution, and fewer recurring issues.



As we optimize support, you'll focus Tier 3 on the work where deeper technical expertise has the greatest impact. You'll partner with Engineering and CX Operations on tools, AI, and automation that improve resolution and reduce manual effort, while owning priorities, adoption, and measurable customer outcomes.



You'll also be the senior CX partner to Product and Engineering, turning customer challenges into shared priorities for better products, more reliable service, and stronger launch readiness.




SOME OF THE THINGS YOU’LL DO:



Design and launch Tier 3

 - Define Tier 3’s mandate: Establish the operating model and escalation criteria, with clear ownership boundaries across Tier 2, Product, and Engineering.

 - Build the technical foundation: Define the capabilities needed to resolve complex issues across APIs, integrations, MCP, telecom, and AI products.

 - Create a phased roadmap: Plan team structure, specialist roles, tooling, access, and email and phone support.

 - Prioritize investments: Make clear tradeoffs

Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai https://shield.ai/. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/shield-ai, X https://x.com/shieldaitech, Instagram https://www.instagram.com/shield_ai, and YouTube https://www.youtube.com/@Shield_AI. 

 


JOB DESCRIPTION:

The Head of Product Design will define and lead the user experience vision for Hivemind, Shield AI’s autonomy development platform. This role is responsible for transforming complex autonomy, robotics, AI, and developer workflows into intuitive experiences that enable engineers, operators, and organizations to develop and deploy resilient autonomy at scale. 

A major focus of this role will be shaping the next generation of AI-native and agent-driven workflows across the autonomy lifecycle. As Hivemind evolves from traditional software tooling toward AI-assisted autonomy development, simulation, evaluation, deployment, and operations, this leader will help invent entirely new ways for users to collaborate with AI systems, agents, and foundation-model-powered tools. The ideal candidate has deep experience designing AI products, developer platforms, or complex technical systems and can translate emerging AI capabilities into workflows that dramatically improve user productivity and outcomes. 

This is a highly hands-on role as this leader will manage a team of elite designers. During the first 6–12 months, most of the time will be spent conducting user research, designing experiences, prototyping concepts, facilitating product discovery, and partnering directly with Product and Engineering teams to define the future of autonomy development. 

What you'll do:

 - 


USER RESEARCH & PRODUCT DISCOVERY 

 - Lead customer research efforts across product development, customer engagement, and solutions teams to identify pain points, workflows, unmet needs, and product opportunities. 

 - Establish scalable mechanisms for gathering, synthesizing, and communicating user insights throughout the product development lifecycle. 

 - Translate customer and operational feedback into actionable product recommendations, requirements, and design initiatives. 


PRODUCT DESIGN & USER EXPERIENCE 

 - Design end-to-end workflows across autonomy development, simulation, testing, analysis, deployment, and operations. 

 - Create intuitive experiences for highly technical users including autonomy engineers, software developers, operators, and mission planners. 

 - Simplify complex system architectures, data flows, infrastructure tooling, and AI workflows into understandable us

We are seeking a Director of Systems Engineering & Architecture (SE&A) for Shield AI’s Hivemind Enterprise organization, supporting development of our autonomy platform and development ecosystem for AI Pilots. This leader will oversee Systems Engineering, System Architecture, Cybersecurity Engineering, and Safety/Airworthiness Engineering, building the teams and technical practices needed to deliver dependable, software-intensive autonomous systems.

 

You will connect operational product needs to measurable requirements, coherent architectures, and credible verification and assurance evidence. Partnering with Product, Software Engineering, Program Management, and Integration and Test teams, you will embed practical engineering rigor throughout the development lifecycle.

What You'll Do:

 - 

 - Lead the team: Hire, develop, and lead the SE&A engineering disciplines, establishing clear responsibilities, technical standards, and effective cross-functional partnerships.

 - Establish the operating model: Define how SE&A engages with product and engineering teams, prioritizes competing demands, and allocates resources. Establish clear decision rights, escalation paths, and risk-proportionate engineering practices that improve delivery without unnecessary process overhead.

 - Own requirements and architecture: Guide requirements development and management, system modeling, architectural trade studies, interface definition, traceability, and change impact analysis.

 - Drive verification and validation planning: Establish system-level verification and validation strategies, measurable acceptance criteria, and evidence expectations. Partner with integration and test teams to demonstrate end-to-end capability.

 - Support software development: Integrate systems engineering and architecture into iterative planning, design, implementation, testing, release readiness, and sustainment.

 - Lead integrated assurance: Ensure cybersecurity, safety, and airworthiness considerations shape requirements, architecture, development, and verification from the outset.

 - Guide technical decisions: Lead risk-based design reviews, resolve cross-team technical issues, and provide evidence-based readiness recommendations while preserving designated approval and risk-acceptance authorities.

About the role:

We're hiring a hands-on Director of Enterprise Security to lead Security Engineering, the Security Operations Center (SOC), and Identity & Access Management (IAM). You'll own security across the whole enterprise: end-user computing, applications, data, SaaS, cloud, international sites and manufacturing. You'll set technical direction, build strong teams and turn strategy into measurable results in a fast-moving defense-technology environment.


Key Responsibilities:

 - Lead and grow the Security Engineering, SOC and IAM teams. Hire, mentor and build a high-performing culture.

 - Provide hands-on technical leadership on architecture, tooling and engineering decisions. Act as the senior technical authority for enterprise security.

 - Own security architecture and controls for endpoints, applications, data, SaaS, cloud, international locations and manufacturing/OT environments.

 - Run 24x7 detection, response and threat-hunting capabilities, and mature incident response playbooks and metrics.

 - Drive the IAM strategy, including identity lifecycle, SSO/MFA, privileged access and zero-trust principles.

 - Align security programs with defense compliance requirements (NIST SP 800-171, CMMC, DFARS, ITAR/EAR) in partnership with GRC, IT and Legal.

 - Set the roadmap, budget and KPIs, and report risk and program progress to executive leadership.

 - Work with Engineering, IT, Manufacturing and Business teams to make security effective while still enabling the business.

We are looking for someone who finds themselves on the cusp of product and engineering and is excited to shape the next generation of products at a company with millions of customers. We exist to create a more connected, compassionate, and confident experience for people with cancer and those who care for them. We make it easier to get answers, access high-quality care quickly, and feel supported throughout treatment and beyond.

Our model combines high-touch human support with powerful technology and AI to bring together everyone involved in a person's cancer journey: caregivers, oncologists, health plans, and employers.

RFA is a leading IT and cybersecurity partner to financial services firms: hedge funds, private equity, asset managers, and the firms that serve them. RFA is part of Titan, which is building the AI workforce for IT.

Titan has raised over $100M from General Catalyst, 8VC, and CalPERS, acquired market-leading IT firms like RFA, and put AI agents into production in large enterprises. We've automated 100K+ tickets across 800+ customers and are leading the industry in service quality. Our tech team has talent from Scale AI, CoreWeave, Vanta, Dropbox, Meta, FiveRings, TwoSigma, Amazon, Harvard, Stanford, and MIT.

Why this role, why now

AI is changing security faster than anything we've seen, and we want RFA to be the one leading it for its clients. RFA's clients answer to regulators, investors, and DDQs, and they expect their IT partner to be the most security-minded team in the room. With Titan's AI agents now working alongside RFA's engineers, we can deliver security that is faster, more thorough, and more proactive than a traditional MSP or MSSP.

We're looking for a CISO for RFA: a security leader who wants to build security for financial firms from the ground up, with AI at the center of how it's delivered.

About the role

As RFA's CISO, you own security for RFA and its clients. You lead RFA's GRC, SOC, and vCISO teams, act as the senior security advisor to client leadership, and make sure RFA itself holds up to the scrutiny of the most demanding funds. You'll report to RFA's COO and work closely with RFA's service delivery and engineering teams, and with Titan's product and engineering teams.

You own and measure success by client outcomes (incidents prevented and contained, audits and DDQs passed), growth and retention of RFA's security revenue, and an RFA that passes every client security review.

This role is remote (US).

In this role you will

 - Set RFA's security strategy and lead RFA's GRC, SOC, and vCISO teams, who report to you

 - Build and run RFA's client security offering: vCISO, managed detection and response, SOC, vulnerability management, email security, and incident response, with AI agents doing the volume and people doing the judgment

 - Be the trusted security advisor to client CFOs, COOs, and CCOs: board and investment committee updates, regulatory readiness (SEC, FINRA, Reg S-P, state privacy rules), and investor DDQs

 - Lead incident response for RFA clients, from first alert to client communication and lessons learned

 - Own RFA's own security and compliance program, including SOC 2 and the security questionnaires clients send us

 - Work with Titan's engineers to make sure the AI agents working in client environments are safe: least-privilege access, guardrails, logging, and audit trails

 - Guide RFA clients adopting Claude, ChatGPT, and Copilot on AI governance: data boundaries, connector and permission review, shadow AI discovery

 - Join sales cycles as RFA's security voice: win the client

TransGrid Energy is a renewable energy company focused on investing, developing, owning and operating utility-scale battery energy storage systems and PV projects. TransGrid has a robust pipeline of projects under construction and in late-stage development, and the Company is actively expanding its energy asset portfolio across the United States.

As an affiliate company of Hanwha Group, a FORTUNE Global 500 company driven by a firm commitment to advancing the clean energy future, TransGrid Energy is striving to shape the renewable energy landscape by providing sustainable and reliable power solutions tailored to meet the energy needs of today and tomorrow.

TGE seeks a General Manager to build and scale its data center infrastructure business, with full ownership of strategy, P&L, capital allocation, commercial growth, project delivery, and operations.

The mandate is to develop and energize TGE-owned, affiliate, and partner-owned land into AI-ready data center campuses. The initial focus is power + land + shell, combining internal land and power development capabilities, partner-originated assets, and TGE’s AI Factory design and build capabilities.

Starting with the NVIDIA partnership and ecosystem, the leader will leverage partners’ assets and customer channels to enter the market and scale. The role will advance Microsoft and other strategic partnership opportunities, establish inference data center joint ventures, and bring partner investment and external funding into the business.

Videa is the most adopted dental AI platform, used by 90,000 clinicians. Our vision is to be the first company to diagnose a billion people.

We connect diagnostics, documentation and daily operations in one platform. Our products span FDA-cleared computer vision, an ambient dental scribe, voice perio charting, and tools that help practices manage performance and claims.

AI is the foundation of that work. Clinicians make the decisions; our models help them catch disease earlier, understand findings and get documentation done without adding steps to their day. This role leads the team building those capabilities.

You'll lead Videa's AI/ML team end to end: people, roadmap, model quality and the path from research to a reliable production feature. You'll own the technical decisions behind systems clinicians use every day, working with Product, Engineering, Clinical, Quality and Regulatory.

Viz.ai is the leader in building and deploying AI-powered Care Pathways and helping doctors do their work. The Viz Platform is deployed in 2,000 hospitals across the United States and trusted by many of the leading life sciences companies. The platform uniquely combines real-time, multimodal clinical data with deep clinician engagement to detect disease earlier, coordinate care teams, and help ensure patients receive the right treatment faster. Founded in 2013, AdAction is a leader in performance-based mobile app marketing, partnering globally to deliver premium users at scale. Our collaborative team prioritizes innovation and strategic decision-making, fostering a dynamic and inclusive culture. AdAction is looking for individuals who thrive in an autonomous work environment, seek out ways to meaningfully contribute to our shared success, and embrace growth both personally and professionally.

Our fully remote workforce is centered in the US, LATAM, UK, and Taiwan. This is a fully remote role open to candidates located in Illinois, Texas, or Colorado.

AdAction is seeking a hands-on Director of Data Science & Engineering to lead our Data function across Machine Learning, Data Science, Analytics, and Data Engineering. You will set the technical direction, develop our people, and strengthen how we use data and scientific thinking to improve products and business outcomes.

Reporting to our VP of Engineering, you will serve as a peer to our Director of Engineering and a member of the Technology leadership team. You will directly manage a small group of Data professionals (ML Engineers, Data Analysts, and Data Engineers).

Our Data professionals remain embedded in cross-functional Mission Aligned Teams (MATs), working alongside Product Managers and Engineers. We make extensive use of AI in our day-to-day work and are looking for an AI-forward leader who actively uses these tools and helps the team adopt them effectively.

Success means a stronger, more independent Data function, more trustworthy analysis and data foundations, and ML initiatives that deliver measurable value.

**Description**

  

**Senior Director, Information Technology**
-------------------------------------------

Location: Spartanburg, SC (on site, five days a week)

Reports to: Senior Vice President or Vice President, Information Technology

Classification: Exempt, full time

### **About the role**

The Senior Director, Information Technology leads one or more technology teams at ACA and is an emerging leader in our succession bench. This is a role for a strong, hands-on technologist who is ready to take on broader leadership and wants to grow toward executive responsibility with active coaching from senior IT leadership and the CIO.

The right person is close to the work. They can design and review solutions, troubleshoot hard problems, and still lead a team that delivers reliably. They want to understand our lending business, not just our systems, and they bring a strong respect for security and compliance.

### **What you will do**

* Lead day-to-day delivery and operations for your teams, setting priorities and removing obstacles.
* Contribute hands on to architecture, design, code and configuration reviews, and incident resolution.
* Guide engineers working in our AI-first model, ensuring AI-assisted work meets our standards for quality, security and performance.
* Partner with product owners and business stakeholders to understand needs and deliver practical solutions.
* Establish and improve team standards, processes and metrics, and use them to drive continuous improvement.
* Work with Information Security, audit and compliance to maintain effective controls and resolve findings.
* Manage vendors and third parties that support your area.
* Recruit, coach and develop team members, and build a collaborative culture of ownership and accountability.
* Communicate status, risks and trade-offs clearly to IT leadership and business partners.

### **What you bring**

#### **Required**

* Typically 10 or more years in technology, including at least 3 years leading engineers or technical teams.
* Deep expertise in at least one technical domain, such as infrastructure and cloud, application development, data engineering, or IT operations, with current hands-on skills.
* A track record of delivering results and making sound decisions under pressure.
* Experience with Agile, DevOps, CI/CD and automated testing.
* Understanding of security principles and secure delivery practices.
* Clear written and verbal communication, and the ability to work effectively with business partners.
* Bachelor's degree in an IT-related discipline, or equivalent experience.

#### **Preferred**

* Experience in financial services or another regulated industry.
* Experience with AWS, C# and .NET, Angular or TypeScript, SQL, Snowflake, Python, Git and Bitbucket, or infrastructure as code.
* Hands-on use of AI coding assistants or AI agents (years of experience with specific new tools are not expected).
* Industry certifications in cloud, security or architecture are welcome

Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

### **ABOUT THE TEAM**

The duty of this organization is to enable our Customers' ongoing Mission Readiness. From the moment they say "go" until the contract is fulfilled. We are only successful when the customer's mission is successful.  
  
Mission Readiness is the post-production shared services organization for Anduril. This team supports the Business Lines and Divisions throughout the lifecycle of their product, from initial sustainment concept through delivery, installation, operation, repair and return. These service offerings also include providing technical publications, training, customer support, connectivity services and other value-added services. To the degree the Business elects, we accept the delegated responsibility for upfront and continued delivery of the committed service solutions. This team endeavors to provide the Business Lines, as our internal customers, shared mission services that are more efficient and cost effective than if they chose to provide them directly. By offering mission support capabilities and capacity that are not "core" to the Business, the Business can focus resources on addressing the next big need while we ensure existing commitments are met.  
  
As Anduril's installed base grows across an increasing number of products and Business Lines, our MRO organization needs to move from a collection of program-specific repair processes and tools to a hardened, scalable operating model. This role is about leading that shift.

### **ABOUT THE JOB**

We are looking for a Director of MRO Transformation to lead the modernization and scaling of Anduril's repair operations. Where our Head of MRO oversees the collective repair function, this Director role owns the transformation agenda: establishing core processes for any Business Line to leverage, selecting and implementing the tools and systems MRO runs on, and driving the change management needed to get a fast-growing collection of programs onto common, scalable rails. You will assess where today's pockets of good activity exist, build the roadmap to modernize them, and lead cross-functional teams through the change without slowing down repair turnaround for products already in the field. We are partnering with a rapidly growing, cash-flow-positive AI company that is transforming how financial institutions serve their customers through advanced conversational and agentic AI.

With approximately $30 million in contracted annual recurring revenue, $30 million in Series A funding, and an established customer base of hundreds of financial institutions serving more than 10 million people, this company has demonstrated significant commercial traction.

The organization is entering an exciting phase of growth, expanding its AI platform, introducing new products, and scaling its engineering organization to support increasing enterprise demand.

We are seeking an exceptional Vice President of Platform Engineering to lead this next chapter.

This is a rare opportunity for a highly technical engineering executive to join at a foundational stage of organizational growth, partner directly with the CEO and CTO, and shape the architecture, engineering culture, and long-term scalability of a sophisticated AI-native platform.

**The Role**
------------

As Vice President of Platform Engineering, you will own the core infrastructure powering a production-grade agentic AI platform.

Your responsibilities will span agent runtime, LLM orchestration, retrieval systems, AI evaluations, enterprise integrations, data infrastructure, fraud-related systems, and agent-authoring capabilities.

You will lead and grow a team of talented engineers while remaining deeply involved in technical architecture, system design, and critical engineering decisions.

This is not a traditional executive role focused exclusively on people management. We are looking for a hands-on technical leader who thrives on solving complex engineering problems, building from the ground up, and scaling systems and organizations through rapid growth.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Platform Architecture & Technical Leadership**

* Own the architecture, development, reliability, and scalability of the company's core agentic AI platform.
* Lead the design and evolution of distributed systems, APIs, cloud infrastructure, and production AI services.
* Drive the development of agent runtime infrastructure, LLM orchestration, retrieval systems, evaluation frameworks, and enterprise integrations.
* Make critical architectural decisions balancing performance, reliability, security, scalability, and engineering velocity.
* Establish technical standards and best practices for building production-grade AI applications.
* Remain actively involved in architecture reviews, technical problem-solving, and engineering design decisions.

### **Engineering Leadership & Organizational Scaling**

* Lead, mentor, and expand a high-performing platform engineering organization.
* Recruit and develop exceptional senior, Staff, and Principal-level engineers.
* Build engineering processes, organizational structures, and technical foundations that support rapid business and product growth.

**Aspire Public Schools NorCal — Senior Director, AI, Data & Systems Engineering**

**Job Description**

**About Aspire NorCal**

Founded in 1998, Aspire Public Schools has served scholars and communities across California for nearly three decades. With Aspire Los Angeles transitioning into an independent organization, the Bay Area and Central Valley regions are coming together to form Aspire NorCal, operating 22 schools serving approximately 10,000 scholars across Northern California (Oakland, Richmond, East Palo Alto, Sacramento, Stockton, Modesto, and Ceres).

This evolution comes at an important moment for Aspire. Changes in California’s funding, policy, enrollment, and operating environment have created an opportunity to rethink how the organization supports its schools and scholars in its next chapter. The formation of Aspire NorCal creates an opportunity to strengthen support for schools across teams previously organized by geography, improve the consistency and effectiveness of school support, and create clear accountability systems for organizational and scholar outcomes. The new model will require the organization to balance greater coherence across Aspire NorCal with responsiveness to the different communities and contexts of its schools.

Aspire NorCal enters this transition with a long-standing mission focused on post-secondary success and a deep commitment to educational equity, along with decades of institutional knowledge across its schools and teams. Preserving those strengths while building Aspire NorCal as a unified region will be central to the work ahead.

**About the AI, Data & Systems Enablement team**

The Data & Systems team exists to give principals, teachers, and teammates their time back. We are responsible for Aspire NorCal's data and the key software systems that cross departments, and we measure ourselves by the experience of the people we serve: a principal gets a trusted answer in minutes if not seconds, a new hire is entered once, and no one navigates five systems to do one job. We use AI to get there, and we set the policy and training that keep it useful and appropriately safe. The team is made up of an Enablement team that builds the shared foundation, plus pods that each serve a customer group: School Operations & Principals, Academics & Teachers, and People & Resources. Our working principles: go deep with users, one shared foundation, self-serve first, learning is the job, and nobody works alone.

**About the role**

Reporting to the Chief Technology Officer (CTO), the Senior Director, AI, Data & Systems Engineering leads the engineering that makes Aspire NorCal's data trustworthy. As the team's technical lead, you are the dedicated owner of the data warehouse, semantic layer, integrations, data governance, and the AI platform. You set and uphold the engineering practices every pod builds on: code control, review, testing, and standard toolkits. You own the integration strategy, set the integration prioriti

CommunityAmerica Credit Union (CACU) is federally chartered and serves members nationwide. Our mission is to help members meet all their financial needs and achieve Financial Peace of Mind. Digital transformation and personalization are central to that mission, and they depend on a modern infrastructure and a sound cloud strategy.

CommunityAmerica Credit Union is seeking a strategic and operational technology leader to serve as Vice President of Infrastructure & Support. This executive is responsible for the strategy, reliability, modernization,security and performance of the enterprise infrastructure and technology support environment.

The VP will lead infrastructure, cloud, network and telecommunications, infrastructure operations, application support, ATM solution and end-user support. The successful leader will balance operational excellence with transformation, ensuring highly available, secure and resilient services while advancing cloud adoption, automation, observability and modernization.

* Establish and mature 24/7 technology operations, proactive monitoring, observability, automated alerting and major incident management.
* Drive cloud and infrastructure modernization, automation, DevOps, lifecycle management and reduction of technical debt.

* Own technology disaster recovery, resiliency, capacity and availability management, including regular testing and continuous improvement.
* Partner with Information Security, Risk and business leaders to maintain strong controls and meet security, regulatory and audit requirements.
* Establish measurable SLAs, operational KPIs, service-quality metrics and continuous-improvement practices.
* Build and retain high-performing teams while fostering accountability, innovation, collaboration and service.

At Compass, our mission is to help everyone find their place in the world. Founded in 2012, we’re revolutionizing the real estate industry with our end-to-end platform that empowers residential real estate agents to deliver exceptional service to seller and buyer clients.

**About Compass International Holdings**

Compass International Holdings is the largest residential real estate brokerage in the United States by sales volume. Founded in New York City in 2012 by Robert Reffkin and Ori Allon, and publicly traded on the NYSE, Compass was built on a simple premise: real estate agents are the heart of the transaction, and great technology makes them dramatically more effective.

Following the combination with Anywhere Real Estate, Compass International Holdings operates a portfolio of the most recognized brands in the industry — including Compass, Coldwell Banker, Sotheby's International Realty, Corcoran, Century 21, and ERA — supporting a combined network of over 300K agents across approximately 120 countries and territories.

What makes Compass International Holdings unusual in this industry is that we build our own software. Our end-to-end Home Platform, the Compass One client dashboard, and our AI assistant are developed in-house by engineering teams across New York, Seattle, Boston, and Miami. Technology is not a support function here; it is the product that differentiates the company. That is what makes infrastructure a first-class concern — and it is the premise of this role. Just as Compass makes agents more effective, Technical Infrastructure exists to make our Product and Engineering teams more effective.

**About the Role**

As Director of Engineering for Technical Infrastructure, you will own the platform that every engineer at Compass builds on. Tech Infra's mission is to empower our engineers to build, test, and ship high-quality software with maximum speed and confidence by providing a reliable, cost-effective "Golden Path" of centralized tools that eliminates operational complexity so product teams can focus on innovation. You will be accountable for that mission across compute, networking, databases, streaming, build and release systems, test infrastructure, observability, developer tooling, and the AI-enabled software development lifecycle. You will support a footprint that today spans more than 1,400 services, hundreds of managed datastores, and thousands of engineers' daily workflows.

This is a manager-of-managers role in a functional area with an expectation to shape the infrastructure architecture and technology strategy for years to come. You will own a domain where the business problem is not always defined for you and the technology strategy could be genuinely open — where part of the job is determining what the right problem is before committing the organization to solving it. board-indeed:compass international holdi.description:
At Compass, our mission is to help everyone find their place in the world. Founded in 2012, we’re revolutionizing the real estate industry with our end-to-end platform that empowers residential real estate agents to deliver exceptional service to seller and buyer clients.

**About the Role:**

The Director of the Security Operations Center owns detection, response, and threat hunting across our production, corporate, and cloud environments. This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will set the direction of the SOC in line with the CISO's security strategy and run a team of senior technical professionals day to day. When an incident calls for it, you will step in personally and lead the investigation and response. You report directly to the CISO and act as their operational partner, so the CISO always has an accurate picture of threats, exposure, and our ability to respond.

**What you will do:**

* Turn the CISO's security strategy into a SOC roadmap, prioritize where detection and response investment goes, and show measurable progress against it.
* Own the end-to-end detection and response lifecycle, from telemetry collection through detection, triage, containment, eradication, recovery, and corrective action.
* Act as incident commander for the highest-severity events. Get hands-on in the investigation, analyze logs, endpoint, network, identity, and cloud telemetry yourself, and make containment decisions under pressure.
* Build, lead, and develop a team of incident response, detection, and threat hunting engineers. Set a high technical bar, coach people through hard investigations, and hold the team accountable for quality and follow-through.
* Hold your ground on technical and risk decisions with engineering, product, IT, and executive stakeholders. Push back with evidence when a decision increases exposure, and escalate clearly when needed.
* Design and evolve the SOC architecture, including SIEM, SOAR, EDR, identity, and cloud detection tooling. Decide what to build, what to buy, and what to retire.
* Drive an automation-first operating model that cuts manual triage, shortens time to detect and contain, and lets the team scale without adding headcount in step with the environment.
* Establish full telemetry coverage across the Compass platform, including acquired environments, so that every critical asset produces attributable, correlated events.
* Lead a threat-informed defense program. Use adversary behavior, threat intelligence, and hunting results to drive detection engineering and active defense capabilities.
* Own the incident response plan, severity definitions, escalation paths, and on-call model. Run realistic tabletop and live-fire exercises that include technical teams and executives.
* Run blameless post-incident reviews and make sure corrective actions have an identified owner, a deadline, and verified completion.
* Define and report the operational metrics that matter, such as coverage, detection fidelity, dwell time,

At Compass, our mission is to help everyone find their place in the world. Founded in 2012, we're revolutionizing the real estate industry with our end-to-end platform that empowers residential real estate agents to deliver exceptional service to seller and buyer clients.

**About Compass International Holdings**

Compass International Holdings is the largest residential real estate brokerage in the United States by sales volume. Founded in New York City in 2012 by Robert Reffkin and Ori Allon, and publicly traded on the NYSE, Compass was built on a simple premise: real estate agents are the heart of the transaction, and great technology makes them dramatically more effective.

Following the combination with Anywhere Real Estate, Compass International Holdings operates a portfolio of the most recognized brands in the industry — including Compass, Coldwell Banker, Sotheby's International Realty, Corcoran, Century 21, and ERA — supporting a combined network of over 300K agents across approximately 120 countries and territories.

What makes Compass International Holdings unusual in this industry is that we build our own software. Our end-to-end Home Platform, the Compass One client dashboard, and our AI assistant are developed in-house by engineering teams across New York, Seattle, Boston, and Miami. Technology is not a support function here; it is the product that differentiates the company. That is what makes infrastructure a first-class concern — and it is the premise of this role. Just as Compass makes agents more effective, Technical Infrastructure exists to make our Product and Engineering teams more effective.

**About the Role**

As Director of Engineering for Technical Infrastructure, you will own the platform that every engineer at Compass builds on. Tech Infra's mission is to empower our engineers to build, test, and ship high-quality software with maximum speed and confidence by providing a reliable, cost-effective "Golden Path" of centralized tools that eliminates operational complexity so product teams can focus on innovation. You will be accountable for that mission across compute, networking, databases, streaming, build and release systems, test infrastructure, observability, developer tooling, and the AI-enabled software development lifecycle. You will support a footprint that today spans more than 1,400 services, hundreds of managed datastores, and thousands of engineers' daily workflows.

This is a manager-of-managers role in a functional area with an expectation to shape the infrastructure architecture and technology strategy for years to come. You will own a domain where the business problem is not always defined for you and the technology strategy could be genuinely open — where part of the job is determining what the right problem is before committing the organization to solving it. Courier Health is on a mission to solve one of the biggest and most meaningful opportunities in healthcare: reinvent how people living with chronic and rare diseases are supported.

We are building the future of patient engagement for life sciences companies. Our software is leveraged by biopharma companies to support patients in their complex journey from diagnosis to initiating and remaining on therapy to achieve optimal health outcomes.

**Come Build with Us**
----------------------

We're an NYC-based team that believes culture, craft, and customer obsession go hand in hand. We show up for each other the same way we show up for the people we serve. We're an office-first company that values in-person collaboration 4 days per week because we believe the best work happens when you can collaborate and brainstorm together in the same room. If that sounds like your kind of place, we think you'll love it here.

**The Opportunity**
-------------------

Courier Health is at an inflection point. We exist to get patients faster, better access to life-saving therapies. Patients trust us with their health information, and the pharma companies we serve trust us to protect it. That trust is what lets the mission scale. This role owns that.

As Director of Security, you will report to the CTO and set direction for security across three surfaces: the Courier platform and the AI agents running on it, how our engineers build that platform, and how we run the company. IT Operations reports through you, and you will set the direction for security architecture across Courier.

This is a build job. We are putting AI agents into patient workflows that touch PHI, and the playbook for securing that is still being written. You will write it. And you will use agents to run a security program that covers far more ground than its headcount suggests.

**What You'll Build**
---------------------

**A platform that earns a pharma security team's trust.** You will set the direction for security architecture of the Courier platform and our AI agents, threat-modeling agent workflows for prompt injection, tool and permission boundaries, and data leakage before they ship. When customers run security reviews, questionnaires, RFPs, and audits, you are the voice across the table. Our platform's security should be a reason they choose us.

**An engineering org that ships securely by default.** Threat modeling, CI guardrails, secrets management, dependency and infrastructure scanning, and a security champions program. You set the direction, and the secure path becomes the easy one. You will hold Courier's own AI use to the same standard: what coding agents and AI tools can access and commit, with frameworks like NIST AI RMF and ISO 42001 treated as engineering requirements, not paperwork.

DawnSecurity is building a next-generation cybersecurity platform. At its core is a hard applied-research problem, and this role owns it: leading our Data Science and Data Engineering team, directing algorithm research, building the models behind the platform, and driving the company's intellectual property.

### **What makes this role different**

This is not a "train a classifier on labeled data" role. The core challenges are:

* Learning without labels. The events that matter most are too rare to train on. Models must be built from structure, statistics, and synthetically generated signal rather than labeled examples.
* Probabilistic modeling over graphs. The problem domain is inherently relational — entities, hierarchies, and connections — and the models must reason over that structure, not just over flat feature vectors.
* Adversarially robust learning. An adversary can influence the data our models learn from. Robustness to manipulation and governed model updates are first-class design constraints.
* Explainability as a requirement. Every score must decompose into a sentence a domain expert can act on. Opaque models that outperform explainable ones by a margin still lose here.
* LLMs as components, not oracles. We use LLMs inside pipelines with statistical quality gates and human-in-the-loop escalation — knowing when not to trust model output is the skill.

### **Core Responsibilities**

### **Research & Modeling Leadership**

* Own the research agenda: from hypothesis through prototype, empirical validation, shadow-mode deployment, and production.
* Design probabilistic and statistical models for sparse, high-cardinality event data — scoring, smoothing, calibration, drift detection.
* Lead graph-based modeling: entity resolution across heterogeneous sources, inference over large graphs, relationship discovery with tiered confidence.
* Combine statistical models with rule- and constraint-based reasoning where the two must agree.
* Define the evaluation discipline: synthetic data, shadow-mode comparisons, calibration audits, and precision targets tied to user trust.

### **IP Creation & Protection**

* Drive patentable inventions from the research roadmap: identify novel mechanisms, validate them empirically, and work with patent counsel on claims.
* Distinguish what to file, what to publish, and what to keep as trade secret — and sequence research disclosures accordingly.

### **Engineering & Operational Excellence**

* Architect the sandbox-to-production path: streaming and batch pipelines, feature stores, model serving with low-latency inference at high event throughput.
* Establish MLOps: versioning of code, data, and models; automated validation; monitoring that triggers governed retraining.
* Balance startup velocity against platform sustainability; keep compute costs proportionate to value.

* Hire, grow, and retain a small, senior DS/DE team in a competitive market.

**The Company**

colliga is building deterministic governance for probabilistic AI systems (large language models to start). It checks what a probabilistic model produces against the rules an enterprise has set, determines admissibility, and keeps a versioned, replayable record of every decision. It works mid-stream, and only returns responses that are fully compliant, thus replacing traditional guardrails.

**The problem**

Businesses deploying AI are discovering that a model usually behaves as trained with current governance techniques, but not always. "Usually" is not good enough for high-stakes use-cases, and therefore not something a regulator, auditor or buyer's legal or security teams will sign off on. As a result, AI is failing to reach its full potential for critical tasks. A governed, logged, deterministic gate can turn "usually" into "always, provably, and with evidence" for many of these systems.

We hold a family of 14 filed patents, have a working prototype and a proof of concept, and are ready to build the first production product.

**The role**

The Chief Technology Officer is the technical owner of that thesis: what is built, what works, what the evidence supports, and what the company can honestly promise customers and investors. You will be the single technical voice who sets direction, arbitrates between competing designs, and leads the engineers who build it.

You report to the founder and CEO. You lead the engineering team and own the code and infrastructure, with authority over technical direction, hiring, architecture, security posture and engineering process. You work alongside the founder on intellectual property with outside counsel and technical reviewers, including investor due diligence.

Summary
  
Fairbanks Morse Defense builds and supports the engines, power systems, and mechanical systems that keep Navy and Coast Guard ships underway. Our technology organization develops the next generation of those products, modernizes the equipment already in the fleet, and guides where FMD invests across its product lines.
  
We are hiring a Director of Technology to lead that organization. You will own three things: technology development and internal R&D investment, the retrofit and upgrade business that modernizes in-service engines and systems, and product portfolio management across FMD. You will set the technology roadmap, lead the engineering and product teams that deliver it, and report to the Sr. Vice President of Strategic Projects.
  
This role is remote, leading a team out of Beloit Wisconsin, with approximately 35% travel to FMD facilities, customer sites, shipyards, and test sites.
  
Why This Role
  

* The full technology lifecycle. You own products from early R&D through military qualification, fielding, and in-service upgrade.
* A fleet that needs modernizing. FMD engines and systems are installed across the Navy, Coast Guard, and Military Sealift Command fleets. Your retrofit and upgrade programs extend their service life, improve readiness, and solve obsolescence.
* A portfolio view across FMD. You see every product line in the company and shape where FMD invests, and sustains.
* Customer and executive access. You work directly with Navy technical authorities, program offices, and research sponsors, and with FMD’s executive team and business leaders.
* A mission that matters. Your products help keep global naval and coast guard vessels powered, ready, and supported.

Principal Duties and Responsibilities
  

* Technology Strategy & Development

**Job Description**

**The Opportunity**

FIS is transforming how we build and operate Capital Markets technology, moving from vertically aligned products toward a platform-oriented engineering model built on shared capabilities, modern architecture, common standards, and strong engineering accountability. This is an opportunity to shape the next generation of technology supporting some of the world’s most complex financial markets and institutions.

The **Head of Product Engineering for Capital Markets** leads technology across a portfolio of businesses spanning trading, treasury, risk, lending, asset management, and post-trade. Partnering closely with Product, this leader translates market strategy and client needs into differentiated, resilient, and scalable products. The role owns how these products are architected, built, secured, modernized, and operated, while evolving the portfolio toward reusable platforms and shared capabilities that improve speed, quality, and economics.

A central part of the mandate is AI transformation. The leader will drive how AI changes the way we engineer products, from software development and testing through modernization and operations, while partnering with Product to embed AI capabilities into our products and client experiences where they create meaningful value.

The role combines stewardship of highly critical financial technology with the opportunity to shape its future. That means protecting the reliability, performance, security, and control our clients depend on while simplifying the technology estate, modernizing platforms, reducing duplication, and making thoughtful enterprise-first decisions about where we invest, standardize, reuse, and retire technology.

As a core member of the Technology leadership team, this leader will help shape FIS’s broader technology direction and engineering culture. We are looking for someone who can lead at scale, build exceptional engineering teams, bring together deep domain and technology expertise, challenge established approaches, and translate technology strategy into measurable outcomes for our clients and business.

**Strategic Mandate**

* **Capital Markets Portfolio Transformation**: Shape the technology strategy and evolution of the Capital Markets portfolio across trading, treasury, risk, lending, asset management, and post-trade. Simplify the technology estate, scale shared capabilities, and create a more coherent architecture while preserving the domain depth, performance, and flexibility required by clients and markets.

--------------------------

Millions of Americans feel politically homeless and left out of the two-party structure. Too many electoral choices are settled before most voters have a meaningful say, and our political system consistently fails to address the nation’s biggest challenges. We are a stealth team building an ambitious cross-partisan political venture to make American democracy more open, competitive, and responsive. We will build the infrastructure to effectively challenge the two-party political establishment, and create fundamentally new pathways to elected office and engaged citizen participation.

**About Us**

At Gifthealth, we're revolutionizing the way people experience healthcare by simplifying the process of managing prescriptions and health services. Our mission is to provide a seamless, personalized, and efficient healthcare experience for all our customers. We're a dynamic, innovative, and customer-centric company dedicated to making a positive impact on people's lives.

**Position Summary**

We are seeking a Director of Data Platform & Engineering to own everything upstream of the business: the ingestion, warehouse, orchestration, and data infrastructure that every report, partner data feed, and agentic AI product at Gifthealth depends on. This position plays a key role in supporting the Data Platform & Engineering team (not labeled as a formal department in the source job description) and reports to the CTO, ensuring alignment with organizational goals, operational excellence, and compliance standards.

**A Day in the Life:**

The Director of IT Service Management leads the design, delivery, and continuous improvement of Hertz’s global IT service management practices. This role turns technology and business priorities into reliable, measurable service operations, supporting a consistent experience for employees and business partners across the company.

Working with Technology and business leaders, the Director oversees key service management processes and the systems that support them, including ServiceNow. The role partners closely with infrastructure, end-user services, application, cybersecurity, and operations teams to improve service quality, system stability, resiliency, and compliance.
