* Use KPIs, service data, and customer feedback to identify performance gaps, manage backlogs, and prioritize process and system improvements.
* Oversee the ServiceNow platform roadmap and backlog, partnering with stakeholders on enhancements, automation, integrations, and adoption.
* Work with Technology and business leaders to improve service quality, operational readiness, system stability, and resiliency.
* Manage the service management budget and assigned resources, balancing service needs, risk, and cost.
* Set expectations for vendors and service providers supporting ITSM processes; monitor service levels, delivery, governance, and cost-effectiveness.

* Communicate service performance, risks, priorities, and improvement plans clearly to executives, business partners, employees, and vendors.
* Build effective working relationships across Technology and the business to coordinate service ownership and resolve operational issues.

**What We’re Looking For:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* ITIL 4 certification preferred;

Description Director, Data Science

Data is at the center of everything we do. As a startup, we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Fast-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data-driven decision-making.

  
  

As a Data Scientist at Capital One, you’ll be part of a team that’s leading the next wave of disruption at a whole new scale, using the latest in computing and machine learning technologies and operating across billions of customer records to unlock the big opportunities that help everyday people save money, time and agony in their financial lives.

  
  

About The Team

Capital One was built on the idea that better data and better models make better credit decisions. The Applied AI in Credit team is working on the next chapter of that story. We apply AI models to credit decisioning. These models learn from the full history of how a customer uses credit, and putting them to work in lending decisions is cutting-edge work for the US industry.We own the work end to end. We fine-tune and build models for specific credit decisions, prove them against the models we use today, make them explainable enough to meet the bar that fair lending and model risk management require, and carry them into live credit decisions. Along the way we partner closely with Capital One’s AI researchers on one side and the credit teams who run our card business on the other.

We hire across a range, from data scientists who love building models to analysts who know credit deeply, and we look for people who want to grow toward the other end. If you want to help shape how AI is used in lending, we’d love to talk.

**Description**

Leidos is hiring a Director of DevOps to lead the engineering organization's delivery platform: the pipeline that takes software from a developer's commit to a signed, approved release across commercial cloud and accredited government environments. The role is a people-leadership position that reports to the Senior Vice President, Engineering.

**What this role will deliver**
-------------------------------

The Director will deliver a single, trusted release pipeline that takes every engineering team's software, whether enterprise applications or hardware-bound and machine learning workloads, from commit to approved release, with full provenance (a verifiable record of how the software was built) and built-in security evidence, so that accreditation and security reviews draw on data the pipeline already produced. Commercial cloud and accredited government environments will be consistent and reproducible, so a build that passes in one behaves the same in the other.

Production services will run to published reliability targets, with working observability and a well-run on-call practice, and every significant incident will end in a blameless review with tracked fixes. Engineering teams will see shorter lead times through standard, self-service tooling, and leadership will get release-readiness data early enough to inform go or no-go decisions.

The Director will also build and retain a high-performing team of DevOps, site reliability and release engineers, manage vendor and partner relationships, and keep cloud and compute spend within budget.

**Location:** The ideal candidate will be based in Northern Virginia or near another Leidos facility, such as Huntsville, AL, or San Diego, CA. Onsite work at a Leidos facility is required as business needs dictate.

**Required qualifications**
---------------------------

* Active Top Secret clearance, with the ability to obtain Sensitive Compartmented Information (SCI) access
* Experience leading DevOps, site reliability engineering or platform teams, with the ability to hire, develop and lead engineers, manage a budget, work with vendors and partners, and influence senior executives
* Proven record of designing and running continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines at scale, backed by measurable gains in lead time, deployment frequency, change failure rate and recovery time
* Hands-on experience in software supply chain security, including software bills of materials, artifact signing, provenance and vulnerability management in a regulated environment
* Deep technical experience with commercial cloud platforms and infrastructure as code, containers and Kubernetes, and Linux systems administration
* Working knowledge of federal security and accreditation frameworks such as the Federal Risk and Authorization Management Program (FedRAMP), National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) Special Publication 800-53 and Department of Defense (DoD) cloud impact levels

**Position Summary**

Own the technical platform of Loop Dynamics, including engineering, commissioning, water quality, verification, technical standards and technology-enabled field delivery. The CTO is accountable for ensuring every service is engineered, measurable, repeatable and defensible across markets.

**Primary Outcomes**

· Engineering, commissioning and water-quality services operate under one controlled technical standard.

· Flush plans, hydraulic calculations, temporary systems and acceptance criteria are safe, accurate and executable.

· Technical deliverables and field data support customer acceptance with minimal rework or dispute.

· The company develops differentiated capabilities in liquid cooling, CDUs, water reuse and advanced fluid management.

· Technical systems, data and intellectual property increase scalability and enterprise value.

**Key Responsibilities**

· Set companywide technical strategy, engineering standards and technical-service roadmap.

· Lead engineering governance for hydraulic calculations, temporary pumping/filtration systems, bypass plans, equipment sizing and system segmentation.

· Own commissioning and verification methodology, turnover documentation and acceptance-framework development.

· Oversee water-quality, filtration, chemistry, passivation, glycol and treatment standards through the Water Treatment Specialist.

· Establish QA/QC technical requirements, calibration expectations, nonconformance processes and technical audits.

· Develop technical SOPs, standard calculations, templates, digital forms, field data architecture and intellectual property.

· Review high-risk or unusual projects and approve technical deviations from standard practice.

· Partner with Sales/Estimating on technical strategy, scope definition, proposal risk and strategic customer presentations.

· Build relationships with engineers, commissioning agents, OEMs, labs and technology partners.

· Lead development of liquid-cooling/CDU, water-reuse and next-generation mission-critical fluid services.

**Decision Rights & Authority**

· Final technical authority for company engineering and service standards within executive-approved risk limits.

· Approve or reject technical deviations, acceptance methods and high-risk temporary-system designs.

· Stop work when technical conditions create unacceptable system, quality or customer risk.

**Key Performance Indicators**

· First-pass technical acceptance

· Engineering / submittal turnaround

· Technical rework / NCR rate

· Commissioning and closeout cycle time

· Water-quality acceptance / retest rate

· New-service and technical-IP development

**Preferred Qualifications**

· 12+ years of engineering, commissioning, hydronic systems, water treatment or mission-critical technical leadership preferred.

· Strong understanding of hydronic systems, pumps, filtration, heat-transfer fluids, controls and commissioning processes.

· Professional engineering licensure is preferred

This role must possess extensive knowledge in an IT discipline critical to IT operations and a broad knowledge of related domains (e.g., AI/ML, cloud services, cyber security, penetration testing, architecture). PopUp Bagels is not just a bagel company—we’re a cultural movement. Our stores are small, our vibes are loud, and our energy is contagious. From signature neon and iconic bullhorns to our “Not Famous but Known” mirror, we’ve reimagined not just how a bagel is created, but how it’s enjoyed: Grip, Rip and Dip! **ABOUT POWER FACTORS**

Power Factors is a software and solutions provider leading the next generation of clean energy with Unity, one of the most extensive and widely deployed renewable energy management suites (REMS) in the market. With over 300 GW of wind, solar, and energy storage assets managed worldwide across more than 600 customers and 18,000 sites, Power Factors manages 25% of the world’s renewable energy data.\*

Power Factors’ Unity REMS supports the entire energy value chain, from monitoring and controls to market analytics. The company’s suite of open, data-driven applications empowers renewable energy stakeholders to collaborate, automate critical workflows, and make more informed decisions to maximize asset returns. Energy stakeholders receive end-to-end support, including solutions for SCADA & PPC, centralized monitoring, performance management, commercial asset management, and field service management.

With deep domain expertise, AI-powered insights are delivered at scale so businesses can optimize assets, unlock growth, and make smarter decisions as the world rapidly transitions to clean energy. Power Factors fights climate change with code.

* Outside China and India

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

Power Factors is scaling in complexity — more products, more platforms, more sophisticated buyers, and rapidly rising expectations for AI-native capability across our renewable energy software suite. In that context, the absence of a single, accountable technical vision creates real risk: divergent architectural patterns across verticals, inconsistent approaches to AI and data platform investment, and technical debt that compounds faster than it can be paid down.

The Head of Software Architecture exists to close that gap. This is a hands-on, deeply technical leadership role responsible for defining and enforcing enterprise architecture standards across Power Factors' Product & Technology organization — spanning Platform, SCADA, EMS, APM, CloudOps, and CAM/FSM/Product Ops — while personally architecting and prototyping the hardest problems the organization faces, particularly around AI-based product introductions, IoT data acquisition, and multi-tenant SaaS scalability.

This role combines the strategic scope of an enterprise architect with the credibility of a builder who still writes code, reviews pull requests, and is comfortable being the most technical person in the room.

### **Purpose of the Role**

The Head of Software Architecture acts to define, evangelize, and enforce a coherent technical architecture strategy that allows Power Factors to scale product complexity without sacrificing reliability, security, or development velocity.

* **Enterprise-wide architectural coherence:** Technical decisions across verticals are grounded in shared architectural principles, not siloed team preferences.
* **AI-native product development:** New AI-based product capabilities are architected end-to-end — from data pipeline to model integration to u

**Make a Difference in YOUR Career!**

Our vision is both simple and ambitious: to put our drinks on every table.

We are the leading global independent beverage solutions provider. We serve a broad range of national and international retailers as well as Global, National and Emerging (GNE) brands. Our products are distributed worldwide from our production sites in Europe, North America, and Australia. Although our own branding may not appear on the labels of the beverages we produce, there is a good chance you are reading this while sipping one of our drinks.

Our ambition is to continually improve and it’s what keeps us at the top of our game. We are solutions-based. We are innovative. We seek out new challenges and conquer them. This is our company ethos, but it’s our people’s too: Refresco is at the cutting edge of a fast-moving industry because we have passionate people pushing the boundaries of what’s best.

Stop and think: how would **YOU** put our drinks on every table?

**Summary Description:**

* Reporting to the Vice President of Engineering and Project Management, the Director of Engineering drives improvements within the operations maintenance organization across 5+ facilities in the assigned region of Refresco NA. This role is responsible for advancing production technologies by applying sound maintenance and reliability principles. This role also ensures the effective execution of capital projects, equipment reliability, and continuous improvement initiatives to drive operational excellence. The Director of Engineering directly manages a team of Project Engineering Managers, each responsible for overseeing engineering efforts across multiple facilities within their assigned regions.

**Essential Functions:**

* Develop a support organization capable of managing plant maintenance operations regionally in US and Canada.
* Deliver criteria to determine whether the Maintenance Organization is fulfilling the needs of each Plant.
* Develop and manage engineering and maintenance budgets across all locations, ensuring effective resource allocation for seasonal rebuilds, equipment needs, and capital projects. Monitor expenses to optimize costs and maintain alignment with company financial objectives.
* Oversee the planning, execution, and prioritization of plant-driven capital projects to ensure alignment with company standards, cost-effectiveness, and business needs.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop and implement new initiatives that enhance capacity, flexibility, cost efficiency, and quality across facilities.
* Provide strategic oversight on staffing, performance management, and workforce planning to meet business objectives.
* Lead the implementation of SAP Maintenance throughout the system.
* Other duties as assigned, including special projects that may require significant travel to manufacturing plant locations.
* Work as an integral member of the engineering, maintenance and Infrastructure design and installation

**ABOUT RETOOL**

Nearly every company in the world runs on custom software for critical operations like tracking performance metrics, handling support workflows, building admin dashboards, and countless processes you might never have thought of. But most companies don't have the resources to properly invest in these tools, leading to a lot of old, clunky internal software, or worse, teams still stuck in manual and spreadsheet workflows.

AI has changed who gets to build software. The definition of "developer" now includes analysts, operators, and domain experts creating solutions directly—and the tools they reach for are multiplying by the week. That's both an opportunity and a challenge: as more people build with more AI tools, the risk of shipping ungoverned software into production grows just as fast.

At Retool, we're building the platform that makes all of it safe to ship. Build with any AI tool you want, then deploy into one place that connects to your real business data, enforces enterprise policies automatically, and lets teams create once and reuse everywhere with shared, trusted components. The cost of building software has collapsed. The cost of governing it hasn't—and that's the problem we solve.

Developers and domain experts have already automated over 100 million hours of work on our platform, freeing them to focus on creative problem-solving and strategic work that drives real business value. The people closest to the problem can now build the software to solve it, safely, and within enterprise guardrails.

Let's build the future together.

  

**WHY WE’RE LOOKING FOR YOU:**

We’re looking for a Director of Engineering to lead Retool’s Core AI Experience—the product experiences that help people turn business problems into working software with AI. You’ll shape how users go from an idea to an app or agent connected to real data, and how they test, refine, and confidently put what they build into use.

Building with AI changes what users expect from Retool. Getting to a first version should feel quick, but the experience also needs to hold up as requirements become more complex. Users need to understand what AI has built, guide its decisions, and move fluidly between generating software and editing it directly. Your teams will make those interactions intuitive, reliable, and useful for real business work.

This role sits at the intersection of product engineering, developer experience, and applied AI. You’ll partner closely with Product and Design to define the core experience, make technical investments that improve quality and speed, and build teams that learn quickly from customers. We’re looking for someone with strong product judgment, technical depth, and the ability to turn an ambitious direction into focused execution.

**WHAT YOU’LL DO:**

------------------

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

**About Runware**
-----------------

Runware is the AI inference platform that builds and operates its own infrastructure, end to end. One API gives developers access to image, video, audio, 3D and language models, and our Sonic Inference Engine runs them on hardware we designed ourselves: custom servers, custom boards and a closed-loop, water-free cooling system, packed into Sonic Inference Pods — roughly 1 MW of liquid-cooled GPU compute in a 20-foot container that can be sited wherever power is cheap and available.

This is why infrastructure at Runware is the product, not a cost center. Our edge is that we run inference 30–90% cheaper per GPU-hour than our peers, and that edge is earned in the data center: in how fast we can stand up a new site, how tightly we run our fleet, and how little downtime our customers ever see. More than 20 billion requests have run through the platform for over a million developers, with customers such as Wix, Quora, Freepik and Higgsfield building production applications on top of it.

We raised a $50M Series A led by Dawn Capital, with Comcast Ventures, Speedinvest, Insight Partners and a16z speedrun participating, and we are now building out a global network of pods across the US and Europe. We need someone to own how that network is operated.

**The role**
------------

As Head of Infrastructure Operations, you'll own the physical and operational backbone of Runware: the servers, storage and networking across every site we run, and the team that keeps them running. You'll take us from a handful of pods to a global fleet, and you'll decide how that fleet is built, provisioned, monitored, maintained and scaled.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You'll set the operating model and hire the team, but you'll also be in the terminal, in the rack and in the incident channel when it matters. The people who do best here are senior operators who never stopped being engineers, who are already using AI tools to multiply their own output, and who know what a high-performance infrastructure team looks like because they've built one before.

You'll report to Risto Haukioja, Head of AI Infrastructure and work closely with the hardware, platform and inference engineering teams, and with our data center, power and hardware partners.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Build and run global infrastructure operations across our pod sites in the US and Europe: site bring-up, rack and stack, cabling, power and cooling integration, burn-in and acceptance, through to steady-state operations and decommissioning.
* Own the server, storage and network layers of the fleet end to end: Linux fleet management, bare-metal provisioning and imaging, firmware and driver lifecycle, high-throughput storage for model weights and caches, and the data center and inter-site networks that tie it together.
* Define how a new site goes live, then make it faster every time. Turn pod deployment into a repeatable, documented, largely automated playb

Our technology solutions power the tools you use every day-including smartphones, electric vehicles, hyperscale data centers, IoT devices, and so much more. AI is changing data center infrastructure faster than any cycle before it, and memory is at the center of that change. You will be leadership's go-to source for weekly market sensing, build trusted relationships across the data center ecosystem, and work across Product Marketing, Sales, Product Planning and global headquarters teams. * Summarize key takeaways from internal and external meetings, conferences and customer engagements, and share them with leadership and relevant teams quickly and consistently.

* Partner with the SVP of Technology on hiring, performance, and succession planning for the IT organization

* Own the server compliance and corporate cloud footprint: Ubuntu se

At Shutterfly, we make life's experiences unforgettable. We believe there is extraordinary power in the self-expression. That's why our family of brands helps customers create products and capture moments that reflect who they uniquely are.

The Sr. Director of Business Systems will report to the CIO and is responsible for overseeing all aspects of Shutterfly's business application landscape, including ERP, Finance and Supply Chain systems. Extensive experience with the SAP ecosystem is a requirement, including but not limited to S/4HANA, BASIS, PO, GRC, ECP, IBP, SF, WM, RISE, Ariba, SAC and Concur. The leader will need to help define and oversee the implementation of best-in-class business system standards, architecture and processes to maximize efficiency, productivity, availability and value across many business segments.

The Sr. Director of Business Systems must have solid leadership experience and excellent verbal and writing communication skills. Along with the CIO, the leader will need to proactively plan and align a Shutterfly specific business systems roadmaps. This position will be responsible for managing; People, projects, day-to-day support, budgets, multiple MSPs and ensure efficient business systems processes are maintained and followed to meet key business objectives. Understanding and utilizing the latest AI technologies within the business systems landscape is a must. Defining and establishing key metrics, KPI's and driving continual improvement based on this data is imperative.

Requirements:

* Perform personnel management tasks including but not limited to staff hiring, performance reviews, employee career development, etc.
* Work with other IT managers, business leaders, stakeholders and staff across multiple offices and time zones
* Continually align and communicate with business stakeholders
* Must have experience with software license rationalization
* Must be customer oriented with a strong grasp of the internal customer concept
* Adaptable to change and comfortable driving change management
* Experience working with all levels of employees from individual contributors all the way up to senior executives
* Develop and maintain processes and procedures to ensure business systems are highly productive for our employees and drive value for the overall business
* Work with external vendors, including but not limited to, SAP
* Must have extensive experience managing outsourced MSPs
* Experience working in manufacturing and or an e-commerce business highly desirable
* Familiarity with automation and AI technologies required
* Bachelor of Science in Computer Science (CS) or Management of Information Systems (MIS) is preferred
* Masters in a technical discipline and or an MBA is a plus
* 10+ years' experience in corporate business systems preferred
* 5-10 years' management and strategic experience preferred

Supporting a diverse and inclusive workforce is important to Shutterfly not only because it directly reflects our value

Veracross provides SaaS-based School Information Systems (SIS) designed to meet the specific needs of independent K-12 schools worldwide. Our one-record solution combines the power of a fully integrated single-record database, personalized communication tools, and an elegant architecture that is unique in our industry.

* Establish one intake and scoring process for AI initiatives across operating companies, requiring a named owner, KPI, baseline, cost, and timing, and prioritize by business impact, technical feasibility, AI-versus-human fit, and risk.
* Sequence the portfolio: scale functional use cases first, then AI-enabled VES tools, then domain AI embedded in Veralto’s products and solutions.
* Identify and incubate AI-enabled product and service opportunities with the operating companies, taking ideas from ideation through risk burn-down to market and new areas of revenue.
* Maintain an enterprise view of AI initiatives, owners, adoption, and realized value, and use it to reduce duplication and focus investment where the value is greatest.

Company Overview

We are the better way to work in finance. As private equity’s value creation partner, we sit at the heart of PE—where sponsors and CFOs meet. Through financial consulting rooted in data, technology, and AI, we help clients drive value—supporting the office of the CFO to drive end-to-end value creation.

If you crave challenging work and are looking to grow, come solve complex problems alongside a team of finance and technology professionals in a supportive, collaborative environment.

Backed by leading private equity investors, we are a high-growth, entrepreneurial firm with a global presence. We are looking for people who want to help build something great and make a lasting impact.

Data & Analytics

Accordion's Data & Analytics (D&A) team offers cutting-edge, intelligent solutions to a global clientele, leveraging a blend of domain knowledge, sophisticated technology tools, and deep analytics capabilities to tackle complex business challenges.

We partner with Private Equity clients and their Portfolio Companies across diverse sectors, including Retail, CPG, Healthcare, Media & Entertainment, Technology, and Logistics.

We deliver data and analytical solutions designed to streamline reporting capabilities and enhance business insights across vast and complex data sets ranging from Sales, Operations, Marketing, Pricing, Customer Strategies, and more.

This role can be based in any of our US office locations and is a hybrid role with the flexibility to work remotely 2 days a week. Ideal candidates should be local to the desired location.

We're looking for a rare combination: a data scientist who thinks like a strategist and a strategist who speaks fluent data. You fall in love with problems and quantify complex situations using math. You'll be equal parts analyst, advisor, and architect of our strategic direction.

What You'll Do

You'll sit at the intersection of data and strategy, turning complex business challenges into quantifiable opportunities. This means diving deep into our numbers to surface insights that others miss, then translating those insights into actionable growth strategies. You'll work directly with leadership to shape major business decisions, from market expansion and pricing strategy to resource allocation and competitive positioning.

Your day-to-day will involve identifying the right questions to ask before anyone else thinks to ask them, building the analytical frameworks to answer those questions, and presenting recommendations that fundamentally shift how we operate. You'll own strategic initiatives from conception through execution, measuring impact and iterating as you go. You'll also travel to client sites as needed, based on project requirements.

- Recommend against AI when another solution is better, and keep a portfolio that records what was approved, declined, and retired

Workflow Redesign and Delivery:

- Pilot each use case with defined measures, then scale it, adjust it, or stop it

Quality, Accuracy, and Data Protection:
- Set review standards for AI-assisted work, with the strongest controls on externally facing content such as RFP responses, sales and marketing materials, client communications, and legal and finance documents
- Ensure source verification and human review before AI-assisted work leaves the company
- Keep PHI and confidential information out of general-purpose workflows, consistent with AffirmedRx policy

Governance Partnership:
- Bring every AI use case through AffirmedRx's governance routing (IT Steering Committee and AI Governance Committee) for risk review and approval. This role advances use cases and does not approve its own work
- Document each use case for the AI inventory, and report incidents, exceptions, and lessons learned

Job Description: Data Integration Principal
Role Overview
As the Data Integration Principal, you will serve as a technical advisor for enterprise customers, partners, and internal Customer Success teams. Your mission is to architect scalable, repeatable data integration solutions across the Anaplan ecosystem while driving best practices, technical enablement, and product evolution.
Key Responsibilities
- Provide data integrations expertise for customers, partners, and customer success teams for successful customer deployments using repeatable solutions.
- Build competence by developing methodology, best practices, blogs, demos, webinars, training, and enablement on data integrations.
- Design not only an Anaplan solution, but take into account the wider technology solution and ecosystem for integrating data from various applications.
- Educate and advise customers and partners on data integration options and best practices.
- Interacting with the product organization to provide strategic guidance, share field insights, and actively shape the future direction of the integration product portfolio.
- Be proactive in learning new technologies for both internal and external applications.
- Maintain knowledge of adjunct technologies that support the Anaplan ecosystem including Informatica, Mulesoft, Boomi, SnapLogic.
- Author and share data integration best practices on a continual basis.
- Take complex issues and break them down into simple, manageable steps and milestones.
- Enable the broader talent ecosystem, both internal and external to Anaplan.

- 7+ years of hands-on Anaplan experience, with a deep understanding of Anaplan platform architecture (Classic and Polaris engines) and data hub design.
- Deep expertise in Anaplan Transactional and Bulk APIs, Anaplan Connect, and native CloudWorks integrations.
- Experience advising IT teams on Integration Best Practices.

greenhouse:anduril industries:5289565007.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The duty of this organization is to enable our Customers' ongoing Mission Readiness. From the moment they say "go" until the contract is fulfilled. We are only successful when the customer's mission is successful.

Mission Readiness is the post-production shared services organization for Anduril. This team supports the Business Lines and Divisions throughout the lifecycle of their product, from initial sustainment concept through delivery, installation, operation, repair and return. These service offerings also include providing technical publications, training, customer support, connectivity services and other value-added services. To the degree the Business elects, we accept the delegated responsibility for upfront and continued delivery of the committed service solutions. This team endeavors to provide the Business Lines, as our internal customers, shared mission services that are more efficient and cost effective than if they chose to provide them directly. By offering mission support capabilities and capacity that are not "core" to the Business, the Business can focus resources on addressing the next big need while we ensure existing commitments are met.

As Anduril's installed base grows across an increasing number of products and Business Lines, our MRO organization needs to move from a collection of program-specific repair processes and tools to a hardened, scalable operating model. This role is about leading that shift.

ABOUT THE JOB

We are looking for a Director of MRO Transformation to lead the modernization and scaling of Anduril's repair operations. You will assess where today's pockets of good activity exist, build the roadmap to modernize them, and lead cross-functional teams through the change without slowing down repair turnaround for products already in the field. About ANELLO:

Founded by pioneers in silicon photonics and navigation sensor technology, ANELLO has developed integrated photonic system-on-chip technology for next generation navigation. ANELLO's SIPHOG™ optical gyroscope is based on its patented photonic integrated circuit technology. Our products are high performance, low-power, much smaller size and weight, at a fraction of the cost of traditional optical gyros used in industrial, aerospace and military applications. They enable reliable and accurate navigation and positioning across autonomous applications and within GPS-denied environments. ANELLO has a growing list of customers in commercial and defense segments and scaling production significantly due in part to contracts in the UAV/USV Defense segments.

The Role:

We are moving our gyroscope and IMU electronics from discrete boards to a single, highly integrated mixed signal ASIC. This chip is the step that takes optical-gyroscope precision into high-volume products. As Director, ASIC Engineering, you will own this chip from definition to production. You will lead the program through a top-tier ASIC design partner to first silicon in less than two years. Then you will build ANELLO's in house ASIC organization and define the chips that follow.

Why This Role:
- Full ownership. One chip, one leader. You make the key decisions, from partner selection to tapeout.
- A hard, interesting chip. Low-noise optical receivers, data converters, precision references, power stages, and an embedded processor that runs the IMU sensor hub, all on one die.
- Build from the ground up. Hire the first engineers, set the flows, and shape the in-house team for future generations.
- Real-world impact. Your silicon goes into navigation systems that people depend on when GPS fails.
- Executive visibility. The ASIC is central to the company roadmap, and you work directly with the leadership team.

What You Will Do:
- Own the ASIC program end to end: scope, schedule, budget, risk, and the tapeout decision.
- Lead vendor selection through RFI, RFP, and RFQ. Select the design partner, the process, and the foundry.
- Lead the design partner at the technical level. Drive the design reviews, and hold a high bar on verification and sign-off.
- Own the specification. Make sure that the ASIC is a drop-in replacement for today's discrete electronics.
- Integrate the work outside the partner's scope: signal-processing RTL, firmware, package, photonics, and test.
- Lead silicon bring-up, characterization, qualification, and the ramp to production.
- Hire a small, strong core team now, and grow it into ANELLO's in-house ASIC organization.

What You Bring:
- BS in Electrical Engineering or a related field. MS or PhD preferred.
- 15+ years in ASIC development, including 5+ years leading ASIC teams or programs.
- Hands-on roots in analog/mixed-signal design or verification. You have designed silicon yourself.
- A record of shipping mixed-signal ASICs from specification to volume

About the role

Chime's Data Science & Machine Learning team powers decisions across the company, from how we protect members to how we build products for them. We're looking for a Director to lead that team through its biggest shift yet: moving from traditional models to a modern, AI-driven approach built on transformers and foundation models. You'll lead managers and staff-level engineers, define what great ML looks like at Chime's scale, and rebuild the practice around it. If you want to shape the future of ML at a company where it directly affects members' financial lives, this is the role.

In this role, you can expect to
- Lead and grow Chime's ML organization, managing managers and staff-level engineers across all of Chime's ML work.
- Set the vision and roadmap for moving Chime's models from traditional approaches to transformer- and foundation-model-based systems.
- Coach your managers to build strong, high-performing teams, and raise the technical bar across the practice.
- Shape the architecture of Chime's ML platform, including how we train, fine-tune, serve and scale models on a modern GPU-based stack.
- Define what good ML looks like at Chime: standards for model development, evaluation, deployment and monitoring.
- Partner with product, engineering, risk and business leaders to turn ML into measurable impact for members.
- Make the call on when to build, buy or fine-tune, and explain the trade-offs clearly to executives.

To thrive in this role, you have
- Deep machine learning expertise, with a well-formed point of view on transformer and foundation models and where they do (and don't) beat traditional approaches.
- Familiarity with GPUs and the modern ML stack, from training and fine-tuning to serving models in production at scale.
- Experience managing managers and staff-level ICs, with the technical credibility to earn their trust.
- A track record of building or transforming an ML practice: hiring, setting standards and growing leaders.
- Experience setting a multi-year ML strategy and turning it into shipped results.
- Clear communication with executives and cross-functional partners; you can make complex ML trade-offs easy to follow.
- Bonus: experience applying ML in fintech or another regulated industry.

About the role

Data Engineering sits at the heart of Chime: nearly every product, analytics and AI initiative runs through the data our teams build. As a Director of Engineering, you'll lead Data Foundations and Insights, managing engineering managers and staff engineers who build the foundations the rest of Chime depends on. You'll partner closely with product, analytics, ML and business leaders to make sure our data reflects the true end state of the business for analysts and AI tools alike. And you'll play a core role in Chime's AI transformation, making sure the foundations are built right from day one.

In this role, you can expect to
- Lead and grow an organization of engineering managers and staff engineers, setting a high bar for quality, reliability and ownership.
- Build strong partnerships with product, analytics, ML, risk and business leaders, and keep them confident in what your org delivers.
- Set the multi-year technical vision and roadmap for Chime's data foundations, and tie each investment to business and member outcomes.
- Make sure our data reflects the true end state of the business, so analysts and AI tools can trust it and act on it.
- Shape the data architecture that underpins Chime's AI transformation, making the right foundational calls early.
- Balance competing priorities across many partner teams, making clear trade-offs and explaining them well.
- Hire, coach and develop leaders, and build a team culture of trust, candor and inclusion.

To thrive in this role, you have
- Experience leading engineering organizations through managers, including managing managers and staff-level engineers.
- A track record of building trusted partnerships with cross-functional partners and senior stakeholders, and keeping them aligned through competing priorities.
- Deep understanding of modern data architecture: ingestion, transformation, storage, governance, and serving data for analytics and ML/AI use cases.
- Experience setting technical strategy and a multi-year roadmap, and making the case for investment to executives.
- Sound judgment on architecture trade-offs at scale (batch vs. real-time, build vs. buy, cost vs. reliability), with the technical depth to earn credibility with staff engineers.
- Clear, concise written and verbal communication with both technical and non-technical audiences.
- Bonus: experience building data foundations for AI and LLM-powered tools, or working in fintech or another regulated industry.

About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

About the role
Cloudflare is hiring a Head of Zero Day Engineering to build and lead the team that turns newly discovered vulnerabilities into verified protection—for Cloudflare and its customers.
High-priority vulnerabilities rarely fit within one team’s boundaries. A fix may require kernel expertise, changes across software dependencies and trust stores, fleet-wide deployment, customer-facing WAF protections, and investigation of prior exploitation. You will bring those efforts together, with clear ownership from initial disclosure through verified remediation.
This is a hands-on engineering leadership role. You will recruit the team, establish its operating model, and build the tooling that makes response faster and more reliable. You will combine experienced human judgment with carefully evaluated AI-assisted workflows—not automate away accountability.
What you’ll do
Build and lead the team
- Establish Zero Day Engineering’s charter, priorities, operating model, and partnerships across Cloudflare.
- Recruit, develop, and lead engineers spanning vulnerability response, exposure analysis, mitigation, patching, artifact provenance, release coordination, and automation.
- Build a sustainable incident-command rotation, clear escalation paths, and effective handoffs across teams and time zones.
- Create a culture of technical depth, calm execution, blameless learning, and shared accountability.
Own vulnerability response end to end

Credible is a leading U.S. consumer finance marketplace, transforming the way consumers access and compare financial products. We operate at a consumer and enterprise level. On the consumer side, we help millions of people make smarter financial decisions by comparing personalized, pre-qualified offers across student loans, personal loans, mortgages, credit cards, and insurance — all without impacting their credit score. RESILIENCE IN THE FACE OF DISRUPTION. DEFCON AI is an insights company that leverages artificial intelligence, mathematical optimization, data analytics, and software engineering for resilient optimization of complex systems.
In today’s dynamically changing world, DEFCON AI’s technology aligns outcomes with operational goals, better decision making, and empowers customers to anticipate assess, and mitigate the impacts of disruptions.

About the Role

We are seeking a Technical Director, Government Program to serve as DEFCON AI’s technical point of contact for a new program supporting a government customer. The program will deliver predictive analytics and decision support into a secure government cloud environment, working alongside the customer’s operations staff and an industry partner.

This role will work approximately 50% onsite at a cleared customer facility in Northern Virginia , with hybrid flexibility based on program needs.

You will own the technical solution and its execution , including the architecture, delivery plan, deployment into the customer environment, and integration across teams. You will work closely with the Program Manager to connect the technical picture to the schedule, risks, and status reporting, while building and leading a small engineering team that grows with the program.

The program will deliver incrementally, beginning with a pilot and expanding into production on the same foundation. Role Description

The Dropbox Business Development team builds strategic partnerships that expand product adoption, create new distribution channels, and drive long-term customer and revenue growth. We are hiring a Director of Strategic AI Partnerships to own a focused portfolio of Dropbox’s highest-priority AI relationships, including OpenAI, Anthropic, and Meta.

You will define and execute multi-year strategies across product integration, distribution, enterprise GTM, commercial agreements, and joint marketing. The opportunity goes beyond maintaining individual integrations: you will identify where Dropbox and each partner can create differentiated customer value, align executives and product leaders around a small number of high-impact workstreams, and move those workstreams from concept through agreement, launch, adoption, and growth.

This role requires enough technical fluency to shape product discussions involving AI assistants and agents, native content experiences, connectors and MCP, authentication and account linking, model and platform capabilities, and governed access to customer content. You will work closely with Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, Finance, Legal, Communications, and senior executives to translate strategic ambition into clear owners, milestones, commercial terms, and measurable outcomes.

The role is based in the San Francisco Bay Area to support frequent in-person engagement with partner teams and Dropbox leadership. Success requires executive presence, product and commercial judgment, and the ability to create momentum in relationships where the opportunity is large but the path is not predetermined.

- Own executive and operating relationships with a small portfolio of Tier 1 AI partners, including OpenAI, Anthropic, and Meta.

- Lead complex commercial and strategic negotiations, balancing customer value, product feasibility, reciprocal economics, data and security requirements, and long-term positioning.
- Drive cross-functional execution from opportunity definition through technical scoping, agreement, launch, adoption, and expansion, with clear internal and external owners.
- Establish executive governance, operating cadences, escalation paths, joint roadmaps, and scorecards that keep the most important workstreams moving.
- Provide market intelligence and a clear point of view on the AI ecosystem, using partner and customer evidence to influence Dropbox product, GTM, and corporate strategy.

Flagship Pioneering invents and builds platform companies, each with the potential for multiple products that transform human health, sustainability and beyond. Since its launch in 2000, Flagship has originated more than 100 companies. Many of these companies have addressed humanity’s most urgent challenges: vaccinating billions of people against COVID-19, curing intractable diseases, improving human health, preempting illness, and feeding the world by improving the resiliency and sustainability of agriculture.

Flagship has been recognized twice on FORTUNE’s “Change the World” list, an annual ranking of companies that have made a positive social and environmental impact through activities that are part of their core business strategies and has been twice named to Fast Company’s annual list of the World’s Most Innovative Companies. Learn more about Flagship at  www.flagshippioneering.com .

At Flagship, we accept impossible missions to enable bigger leaps. Our  core values  guide us through uncertainty and toward lasting impact.

This technical leader turns enterprise priorities into a platform strategy, target architecture, operating model, and investment roadmap for shared models, agent infrastructure, connectivity, context, and standards.

Serving as IT’s engineering counterpart to Pioneering Intelligence (PI), this leader partners with PI, Information Security, Digital Platforms, business functions, and portfolio companies on foundational initiatives, decision rights, and governance.

- Partner with PI to establish open-weight, open-source, and local model capabilities for sensitive, regional, or cost-sensitive workloads, with IT owning the path to supported production service.

About FL128

FL128 is building an adaptive, personalized care system that changes how people search for, find, and interact with healthcare. We are building an agent-native, patient-facing platform that helps someone bring us a health question, get a practical action plan, follow it, generate personalized health evidence, and use that information to guide the next step.

As AI transforms how patients engage with health advice, personal data, and care systems, we have a significant opportunity to reshape healthcare around individuals and build closed-loop care that helps people stay healthier for longer. Our advantage will come from identifying the people we can uniquely serve, building a care loop they want to return to, and making disciplined choices about what to build—and what not to build.

The Role

We are hiring FL128’s first full-time employee: a founding product leader at the Director level, reporting to our co-founders. We are looking for someone who wants to make the product decisions that define a company: a product leader with unusual taste, technical range, patient empathy, and the appetite to build in one of the hardest and most consequential categories in technology. You will own the product direction for the platform and help take a differentiated early product bet, that is already in the hands of its earliest adopters, into its next phase: a focused, durable product company.

This is a technical, hands-on role on a lean, AI-native, agent-focused team. You should be comfortable using agentic coding tools to prototype and investigate ideas, participating in code review, and reading tests well enough to spot when the implementation no longer matches the precise product intent. You will also help build the operating discipline behind the product: a practical cadence for planning, prioritizing, shipping, and learning; clear standards for quality and safety; and decision-making that is fast without being casual.

What You’ll Do
- Partner directly with the founders to turn FL128’s differentiated early product bet into a focused product thesis, a clear roadmap, and a sequence of high-conviction decisions.
- Own the closed-loop care experience end to end: help patients move from uncertainty to an appropriate action, follow through, understand what happened, and know what to do next. Importantly, you are obsessed with ensuring that engaged users keep coming back.
- Build the product operating system for FL128: strategy documents, specifications, success measures, sprint planning, reviews, launch standards, and post-launch learning.
- Lead the platform onto Android, MCP, and other high-leverage consumer surfaces while preserving one coherent, deeply considered patient experience.
- Define the AI and agent layer of the product: what agents can do, what context and tools they need, where a human must intervene, and how quality, safety, and trust are proven in production.
- Work directly with engineering on architecture, scope, instrumentation

About General Atlantic

General Atlantic is a leading global investor with more than four and a half decades of experience providing capital and strategic support for over 885 companies throughout its history. Established in 1980, General Atlantic continues to be a dedicated partner to visionary founders and investors seeking to build dynamic businesses and create lasting value. Guided by the conviction that entrepreneurs can be incredible agents of transformational change, the firm combines a collaborative global approach, sector specific expertise, a long-term investment horizon, and a deep understanding of growth drivers to partner with and scale innovative businesses around the world. The firm leverages its patient capital, operational expertise, and global platform to support a diversified investment platform spanning Growth Equity, Infrastructure, and Strategic Solutions. General Atlantic manages approximately $126 billion in assets under management, inclusive of all strategies, as of March 31, 2026, with more than 900 professionals in 20 countries across five regions. For more information on General Atlantic, please visit www.generalatlantic.com.

Position Summary

General Atlantic is seeking a Senior Director of Infrastructure Valuations to help lead the valuation of the global infrastructure portfolio. Based in New York and reporting to the Managing Director, Global Head of Valuations, this individual will lead key elements of the quarterly valuation process, independently challenge investment-team assumptions and third-party valuation analyses, and present well-supported fair-value conclusions to senior stakeholders. The role requires deep infrastructure knowledge, strong technical judgment, and the ability to work credibly with investment professionals, finance teams, auditors, and valuation advisers. The successful candidate will combine hands-on analytical depth with executive presence and will develop members of the valuation team.

Valuation Leadership and Execution:
- Lead quarterly valuations for global portfolio of infrastructure investments across the Energy, Digital Infrastructure, and Long-Life Infrastructure strategies, including operating assets, development-stage projects, and platform structures.
- Review and independently challenge valuation models, forecasts, discount rates (including country, currency, and company-specific risk premia), terminal-value assumptions, capital structures, and other key inputs, focusing on the principal drivers of value and risk.
- Evaluate valuation approaches across sectors and instruments, including discounted cash flow, market and transaction multiples, yield-based methods, scenario analysis, and other techniques appropriate to the facts and circumstances.
- Assess the valuation implications of transactions and material portfolio developments and advise on complex or judgmental matters.
- Ensure that valuation conclusions are supported by high-quality documentation and

GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

* Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As the Director, Technical Architects on GitLab's AMER Professional Services team, you oversee one of the most technically credible and customer-facing groups in the organization. This team helps turn customer priorities into real adoption and measurable outcomes by guiding complex implementations, shaping new service patterns, and bringing emerging GitLab capabilities into production environments.

You'll own the Global Technical Architecture practice across both presales and delivery, managing a team of AMER Technical Architects who work on complex customer needs, early-stage offerings, and strategic engagements. This role is well suited for someone who can coach senior technical talent, bring structure to ambiguity, and keep the team focused on customer outcomes instead of task completion.

In your first year, you'll focus on stabilizing and growing the team, tightening the link between presales scoping and delivery, and turning field work into repeatable offerings. You'll work alongside architects in areas including AI, security, and broader platform architecture, while helping the team turn what they learn in the field into repeatable methods that can scale across Professional Services.

Some examples of our projects:
- Running technical discovery, scoping, and delivery for complex Professional Services engagements in AMER
- Turning early customer work on new GitLab capabilities into repeatable delivery kits, standards, and service patterns

What you’ll do
- Hire, manage, and develop a growing AMER Technical Architecture team, including Intermediate, Senior, and Staff Technical Arc

We take play seriously. We’re looking for curious adventurers ready to find their party, fueled by imagination and drive to build what’s never been built before. At Hasbro and Wizards of the Coast, you’ll collaborate with passionate teams to reimagine our iconic brands and create experiences that spark joy, connection, and community through the magic of play. This is your chance to shape legendary play that lasts a lifetime.

Job Overview

Hasbro is looking for an engineering-focused leader to oversee Finance Applications Engineering and transform our Finance and Treasury technology ecosystem. In this role, you will shape how Finance teams build and use technology while leading and developing a high-performing technical team. This leader will manage the ongoing operation and upgrade of our primary Finance platforms — including SAP’s S/4HANA, expense management tool Concur, treasury solution REVAL, financial planning system Longview, and our Licensing/royalty and rights-management systems (Alliant/Rightsline, IPM from Fadel). They will also lead a major change in how the team delivers new functions by crafting tailored microservices, interfaces, and automated solutions using advanced technology on and around these systems instead of depending only on native configuration.

The ideal candidate will have strong accountability for enterprise Finance platforms along with practical engineering leadership. They will build cloud-native, API-first, and technology-enhanced solutions to expand the functionality of our core applications. This position combines maintaining a reliable, well-controlled Finance technology infrastructure with leading the group’s evolution into a forward-looking product-engineering organization that develops smart, automated financial processes.

You will partner closely with senior Finance leaders as a strategic liaison between IT and Finance, while leading, mentoring, and developing a high-performing technical team.

Location and Work Arrangement

This role is based at our Boston, Massachusetts office and follows a hybrid schedule designed to support in-person collaboration. Employees are expected to work onsite on Tuesdays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays, with the flexibility to work remotely or onsite on Mondays and Fridays.

- Develop and implement a Finance & Treasury applications strategy and roadmap that maintains investment in core platforms (S/4HANA, Concur, treasury risk management tools, financial planning software, and rights administration systems) alongside a growing collection of custom microservices, APIs, and advanced capabilities.
- Guide the team’s shift from a configuration-focused approach to a product-engineering model for Finance systems. New capabilities will be delivered more through code, integration, and automation instead of only using native application customization.
- Develop and manage microservices and APIs that improve the financial modules of SAP S/4HANA along with Concur, REVAL, Longv

greenhouse:icon:6254237004.description:
ICON builds robotic systems that construct multi-story buildings. The company launched Titan commercially in March 2026, has raised over $550M, and holds more than $360M in government contracts across the Army, Air Force, DARPA, and NASA. That growth means more printers in the field, more sites running concurrently, and a larger installed base that has to stay productive.

This role owns Engineering Services: the team that keeps ICON’s printer fleet and site equipment reliable, supportable, and current. That includes sustaining engineering, engineering change management, reliability and root-cause analysis, and the technical content field and operations teams run on. New product design stays with Hardware Engineering; Engineering Services owns everything after release.

You will report to the VP, Operations Technology and work daily with Hardware Engineering, Construction Operations, Field Service, Supply Chain, and Quality. You are accountable for fleet uptime, change velocity, and building the service engineering function to match a growing installed base.

Responsibilities

Fleet Reliability & Sustaining Engineering
- Own reliability performance across deployed Vulcan, Phoenix, and Titan systems; set uptime and MTBF targets with Operations and report against them.
- Run root-cause analysis on recurring field failures and drive corrective designs through to release and fleet retrofit.
- Prioritize and manage the sustaining backlog against site schedules, parts availability, and cost.

Engineering Change & Configuration Management
- Own the ECO process end to end, including impact assessment, approval, documentation, and rollout to units in the field.
- Maintain as-built configuration control across the fleet so Operations, Supply Chain, and Service know exactly what is deployed where.

Service Readiness & Technical Enablement
- Deliver the service manuals, procedures, training content, and diagnostic tools that technicians and site crews depend on.
- Define spares strategy and serviceability requirements with Supply Chain and feed them back into new product programs.

Team Leadership
- Lead and grow a team of engineers and managers; set priorities, develop people, and manage the department budget.
- Represent Engineering Services in cross-functional planning with Hardware, Operations, and Prime program leadership.

Required Qualifications
- 10+ years in mechanical, electromechanical, or systems engineering, including 5+ years leading engineering teams.
- Experience owning sustaining engineering, reliability, or service engineering for complex deployed hardware (heavy equipment, robotics, industrial machinery, or similar).
- Hands-on experience running engineering change and configuration management processes.
- Track record of leading root-cause investigations and driving corrective actions to closure.
- Based in or willing to relocate to Austin, TX; this role is on site.

Description

Keeper Security is hiring a Director of IT Operations to lead our global enterprise IT function. This role will oversee IT infrastructure, end-user support, identity lifecycle management, IT service management, business continuity, vendor relationships and IT operations for Keeper’s distributed workforce. This is a 100% remote position, with the opportunity to work a hybrid schedule for candidates based in the El Dorado Hills, CA or Chicago, IL metro area.

Keeper’s cybersecurity software is trusted by millions of people and thousands of organizations globally. Keeper is published in 23 languages and is sold in over 150 countries. Keeper Security is one of the fastest-growing cybersecurity software companies that protects thousands of organizations and millions of people in over 150 countries. Keeper is a pioneer of zero-knowledge and zero-trust security built for any IT environment. Its core offering, KeeperPAM®, is an AI-enabled, cloud-native platform that protects all users, devices and infrastructure from cyber attacks. Recognized for its innovation in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for Privileged Access Management (PAM), Keeper secures passwords and passkeys, infrastructure secrets, remote connections and endpoints with role-based enforcement policies, least privilege and just-in-time access. - Lead global IT operations supporting a distributed, multi-site workforce and DevOps organization
- Build, develop and lead the IT Operations team, including staffing, performance management and succession planning

At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

Every ride on Lyft runs on infrastructure. Every match between a rider and a driver, every price, every payment, every map and every arrival estimate depends on platforms that have to be fast, reliable and efficient at a global scale. This role leads the organization that builds and runs those platforms.

Why this role matters

This is one of the most impactful engineering leadership roles at Lyft. You will be accountable for one of Lyft's largest operating investments: the cost of hosting, running and scaling the entire company on a public cloud, including our growing AI infrastructure spend. This role spans the full infrastructure stack, carries one of Lyft’s largest operating budgets, and directly determines how well Lyft’s product works and what it costs to run.

Reporting to Lyft’s Chief Technology Officer, you will lead an organization of approximately 200 engineers, engineering managers and senior technical leaders to efficiently execute on the right goals to drive impact while maintaining a sense of community.

Manifold Bio is a platform biotechnology company pioneering AI-guided protein design and massively multiplexed in vivo screening to unlock tissue-targeted medicines and organism-scale models of living systems. Using proprietary molecular barcoding technology, we screen hundreds of thousands of protein designs simultaneously in living systems, producing in vivo-validated datasets at a scale no one else can match. The datasets power our computational models, which leads to better drug designs, creating a flywheel that gets stronger with every campaign. Our team of protein engineers, biologists, and computational scientists works  across this full stack to pursue programs both internally and with leading pharma companies.

Manifold Bio is looking for our first dedicated IT leader to keep our fast, highly technical company secure and scalable as we grow and expand into new space. Manifold builds what it needs: our scientists write their own workflows, our labs run on automation we designed, and our AI team puts new agents to work every week. This is a hands-on role. You will configure systems yourself, fix what breaks and set the standards that let a fast, highly technical company keep moving. You will not inherit a large team or a finished playbook. You will inherit a technology program already in motion, with single sign-on, a security awareness program and a new network under way, along with runbooks and a working plan, and you will own it from your first week.

You will work closely with our COO, our cloud and data engineers, our AI and computational scientists and our lab automation team. The right person earns trust by being useful first, then makes the case for change in plain language.

Natera is hiring a Senior Director to lead the research, development and clinical translation of AI and computational algorithms for oncology diagnostics, from research prioritization through validation, deployment, and ongoing performance monitoring. Natera’s longitudinal oncology data resources span tumor genomics, ctDNA, transcriptomics, pathology images, and clinical outcomes, creating opportunities to develop and validate models across molecular, imaging, and clinical data. This role turns that data into multimodal AI products that change how oncologists treat patients.

We are looking for a scientific leader with a compelling vision for how foundation models can advance oncology diagnostics. You will shape our foundation model strategy - identifying the highest-value opportunities in longitudinal molecular, imaging, and clinical data, defining the capabilities we need to build, and guiding their translation into clinically useful products. This requires both the imagination to pursue new possibilities and the judgment to establish where these approaches deliver meaningful advantages.  You will lead an established algorithm team, develop its technical and leadership capabilities, and recruit talent aligned with the product roadmap. With Product and other partners, you will set strategy and decide which opportunities move toward clinical deployment.

Build and lead the team: Grow the existing algorithm research team, hire key talent, and set a high bar for scientific rigor and execution.

Own the path from research to launch: Establish development milestones and evidence-based go/no-go criteria from feasibility through validation and launch, with clear ownership, reproducible analyses, and documented decisions.

Set strategy with Product: Partner with Product, Clinical, and Commercial leaders to prioritize clinical use cases, define intended use and success criteria, and make investment, continuation, and stop decisions based on evidence, feasibility, and clinical and business value.

Push the technical frontier: Bring in foundation models and multimodal deep learning, and turn our data into products that set us apart from competitors.

Deliver with quality: Make sure every algorithm is built on clean data, validated rigorously, and monitored after launch, so it holds up for clinicians, patients, and regulators.

- Substantial experience developing computational products, including sustained leadership of multidisciplinary teams and ownership of complex development programs through clinical deployment. Demonstrated scope and impact equivalent to a Senior Director are more important than prior title.

Join the Future of Security at Netskope

Netskope (NASDAQ: NTSK) is a leader in modern security and networking for the cloud and AI era. We secure and accelerate cloud, data, and AI in real time, everywhere. Thousands of customers, including more than 30 of the Fortune 100, trust the Netskope One platform, its Zero Trust Engine, and the powerful NewEdge network to gain full visibility and control without performance trade-offs.

At Netskope, our technology is driven by our greatest strength: our people. We believe that belonging powers innovation, and success is both personal and organizational. We embrace differences in gender, ethnicity, beliefs, ability, and identity, creating an environment where every voice is heard and respected. We empower our employees to bring their authentic selves to work, grow their careers through continuous education and mentorship, and lead with transparency and curiosity. Join a team where you belong, where you are encouraged to be an entrepreneur, and where together, we continue to redefine the landscape of security.

Visit Careers at Netskope to learn more. Follow us on  LinkedIn and  Instagram .

About the Role

As the SVP of Network & Operations, you will lead the architecture, deployment, scaling, and 24/7 reliability of NewEdge, our global cybersecurity cloud network. In this executive role, you will oversee high-throughput, low-latency network infrastructure, multi-region cloud and edge data center environments, customer support, and round-the-clock Network Operations (NOC/SOC). You will ensure carrier-grade availability, sub-millisecond packet inspection performance, and bulletproof operational resilience against massive, distributed cyber threats.

What You Will Be Doing
- Infrastructure Strategy & Scale: Architect, scale, and optimize a globally distributed hybrid/edge network capable of processing tens of terabits per second of inspected traffic across global Points of Presence (PoPs) and public cloud environments.
- Operational Excellence & 99.999% Uptime: Lead global NOC and SRE teams to maintain carrier-grade SLAs, disaster recovery readiness, zero-downtime upgrades, and sub-minute incident response times.
- Edge & Peering Architecture: Direct global transit, peering, BGP routing optimization, CDN integration, and hardware acceleration (SmartNICs/DPUs) to maximize throughput and minimize global latency.
- Capacity Planning & FinOps: Own the multi-million-dollar infrastructure CapEx/OpEx budget, leading vendor negotiations (hardware, data centers, transit providers) and optimizing unit economics as traffic scales exponentially.
- Security & Compliance: Partner with internal CISO/InfoSec teams to ensure operational infrastructure complies with FedRAMP, SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, and Zero Trust security architectures.

The Eligibility & Revenue Systems are the enterprise backbone that makes the employer and health plan business work: they ingest files, determine eligibility, power billing, and integrate incentives so customers can get members into care without friction.  Together they cover Omada's part of the employer and health plan revenue cycle: file ingestion and partner integrations, eligibility, and claims and invoicing.

About Us

Red Cell Partners is an incubation firm building and investing in rapidly scalable technology-led companies that are bringing revolutionary advancements to market in three distinct practice areas: healthcare, cyber, and national security. United by a shared sense of duty and deep belief in the power of innovation, Red Cell is developing powerful tools and solutions to address our Nation’s most pressing problems.

About the Role

We are seeking a Technical Director, Government Program to serve as DEFCON AI’s technical point of contact for a new program supporting a government customer. The program will deliver predictive analytics and decision support into a secure government cloud environment, working alongside the customer’s operations staff and an industry partner.

This role will work approximately 50% onsite at a cleared customer facility in Northern Virginia , with hybrid flexibility based on program needs.

You will own the technical solution and its execution , including the architecture, delivery plan, deployment into the customer environment, and integration across teams. You will work closely with the Program Manager to connect the technical picture to the schedule, risks, and status reporting, while building and leading a small engineering team that grows with the program.

The program will deliver incrementally, beginning with a pilot and expanding into production on the same foundation. Because access, accounts, and authorization will move on the government’s timeline, this role requires someone who identifies those dependencies early and drives them to closure. An active Secret clearance is required on day one .
